jobs.title: Warehouse Supervisor
jobs.location: Fort Mill, South Carolina, United States
jobs.description:
Summary of Position

The Warehouse Supervisor leads the assigned warehouse team to keep solar panel and solar cell manufacturing supplied and shipments moving safely and accurately. The role oversees receiving, storage, production replenishment, inventory transactions, finished goods handling and shipping. The supervisor is accountable for shift performance, physical inventory accuracy, timely enterprise resource planning (ERP) records and effective handoffs between shifts, working closely with Production, Quality, Planning and Logistics.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Verify receipts against purchase orders and shipping documents, including material identity, quantity, condition, lot numbers and pallet identification. Document discrepancies and coordinate resolution before inventory is released.
• Ensure receipts, transfers, production issues, returns and shipment transactions are recorded accurately and promptly in the ERP or warehouse management system. Investigate gaps between physical stock and system records.
• Maintain traceability for wafers, solar cells, panel components, work in process and finished panels using applicable lot, batch, serial and pallet identifiers. Keep ownership, inventory status and storage locations clearly identified.
• Lead cycle counts and physical inventories, investigate variances and recommend corrective actions. Submit adjustments with supporting evidence through the required approval process.
• Apply approved stock rotation, shelf life and storage requirements. Segregate damaged, returned, nonconforming and quality hold material; release or dispose of it only after authorized approval.
• Coordinate replenishment with Production and Planning to prevent material shortages. Verifying the correct material, quantity and lot are staged for each production requirement, including separate controls for wafers and cells.
• Follow approved handling and packaging methods to prevent breakage, contamination and product damage. Confirm applicable storage, chemical handling and contamination control requirements with Quality and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS).
• Coordinate dock assignments, receiving, staging and loading with Logistics and carriers. Verify product identity, panel counts, pallet counts, labels, packing lists and bills of lading before shipment release.
• Verify trailer condition, dock safety, load arrangement and securement against approved procedures. Escalate unsafe equipment or loading conditions before work proceeds.
• Maintain orderly storage locations and clear access routes. Report space constraints, excess or aging inventory, equipment needs and avoidable handling costs; support approved improvements and audit requests.
• Maintain controlled work instructions and transaction records. Implement process changes after approval, train affected employees and perform other related duties within the role and training provided.

Skills

• Excellent communication skills with warehouse workers, purchasing department, and outside vendors.
• Basic understanding of inventory control procedures.
• Proficient keyboarding skills.

Traits

• Extremely organized and able to work with minimum supervision.
• Ability to perform basic math calculations.

Education and/or Experience

• High school diploma or equivalent; at least 3 years of warehouse, inventory or manufacturing logistics experience, including at least 1 year leading or supervising a team.
• Practical ERP or warehouse management system experience, including inventory transactions, barcode scanning, cycle counts and reconciliation. Working proficiency with Excel and electronic records.
• Experience with receiving, production replenishment, shipping documentation and safe forklift or powered industrial truck operations. Ability to complete required site training and operator evaluations.
• Ability to prioritize changing production needs, investigate discrepancies, coach employees and communicate clear instructions and shift updates.
• Availability for the assigned schedule, including applicable night shifts, weekends and holidays, with overtime or coverage adjustments as business needs require.

Physical Requirements

• Must be able to lift and move materials up to 25 pounds independently and participate in team lifts of approximately 60 pounds as required for essential production tasks.
• Must be able to remain in a stationary position or move throughout the production floor for extended periods (for the duration of the shift up to 8+ hours per shift).
• Must be able to operate, position, adjust, or move equipment, tools, or materials necessary for production processes.
• Capable of performing consistent, manual production tasks over long shifts.
• Must be able to work in typical manufacturing environmental conditions, including areas requiring PPE, exposure to noise, and temperature variation.
• Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Compensation and Benefits

• Competitive Market Wages
• Paid Time Off (vacation, sick, and holiday)
• Employee Assistance Program
• Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance Plans
• Employee Assistance Program
• Tuition Reimbursement Program
• Employee Recognition Programs
• Employee PV Panel Purchase Program

Any information provided during the application process will be maintained in accordance with applicable privacy laws and Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) requirements.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US


Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like — and we're just getting started.


We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.


We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds — which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.


Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia — many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.


If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact — this is the place.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Principal Engineer for our New York office, which opened this summer. You'll work alongside our other principals to set technical direction for the company.

We're defining what AI-first product development looks like in practice: the UI/UX, the capabilities, the data models, and the systems underneath them. It's a wide open problem space, and you'll be one of the people deciding which problems matter most and how we solve them.


In practice, that means you'll:

 - Set technical direction. Own the architecture for major parts of our product and make the calls that shape the platform for years to come — then write the code to back them up.

 - Take on our hardest problems. The ambiguous, high-stakes, cross-cutting work: reliability at millions-of-tickets scale, evaluation and quality systems for AI agents, and the foundations other engineers build on.

 - Define how we build with AI. Coding agents are a core part of our workflow. You'll design the tooling, guardrails, and feedback loops that make them effective across the team — and bring the judgment to know when output is ready to ship and when it isn't.

This is a hands-on role. You'll spend most of your time building, and you'll lead through the quality of your thinking and your work rather than through a reporting line.

Our stack is TypeScript, React/Remix, PrismaORM, NestJS, and some Python. Knowledge of the stack is nice; we know great engineers pick things up fast.


 


WE'D LOVE TO TALK IF YOU

 - Have 10+ years of experience shipping software, including time as a staff- or principal-level engineer at a company with high engineering standards

 - Have set the technical direction for a product or platform and lived with the consequences — you can tell us what you'd do differently

 - Have led ambiguous, high-stakes projects from blank page to production, across the stack

 - Make other engineers better through design reviews, mentorship, and the example you set in your own code

 - Use coding agents as a core part of how you build — not just as autocomplete, but as a real development workflow — and have opinions on how teams should use them

 - Want to be early: real scope, real ownership, and real upside at a fast-moving company




WHAT'S UNIQUE ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY?


A culture that's genuinely different. Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it — because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials.


A front-row seat to building something meaningful. We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company — not just execute someone else's vision.


Performance recognized in real time, not on a calendar. Promotions happen when you're ready — leadership meets every six weeks specifically to identify and recognize strong performers, so you're never waiting for an arbitrary review window to move up.


We're AI-native, and we'll make you AI-native too. Every person at Lorikeet uses AI in their day-to-day work (current favourite: Claude Code), with unrestricted access and no usage limits. You'll leave with skills that matter for the next decade of work.


Twice a year, the whole company flies to Hawaii. Headquartered in Sydney, with teams spanning the US and UK — which means getting everyone in the same place is something we invest in seriously. We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place.


A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops. We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid ~two-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. No trick questions, no take-homes that disappear into a void. Just real work, done together.



If you're from an underrepresented background and don't tick every box, please reach out anyway. We know firsthand that diverse teams perform better, and we're proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
A LITTLE ABOUT US

incident.io http://incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.




THE ROLE IN ONE LINE

Commercial AE is where incident.io http://incident.io's growth gets made real - you're in front of the most ambitious digital-native companies out there, and the deals you close show up in the trajectory of the whole business.




WHAT THAT LOOKS LIKE DAY TO DAY

This is a full-cycle AE role with a strong outbound bias. Yes, inbound comes in - but the AEs who thrive here are the ones who don't wait for it. You'll own your own pipeline from the ground up, building target lists, running creative outreach campaigns, and picking up the phone without being asked twice. Outbound here is a craft, not a numbers game.

You'll be selling into VP Engineering, CTO, and SRE leaders at some of the most forward-thinking digital-native companies in the world. Deals typically land in the $40k–$50k range with a clear path into six figures, and a sales cycle of around 45 days means you're moving fast and closing regularly.

We run a pod model - you'll work closely with a BDR and Solutions Engineer rather than whoever happens to be free. That means real partnerships, shared context, and accountability that goes both ways. You'll also work alongside CS from early in the deal, which means handoffs that don't lose the thread.

What makes the selling here different is the product and the story behind it. incident.io http://incident.io is an AI-native platform built by engineers, for engineers - our founders have been on-call, they've felt the 2am page, and they built something to fix it. When you're in a room with a CTO or an SRE lead, you're not pitching software - you're talking to someone about a problem they've lived, and you understand it. That's the edge.

AEs here are AI-forward in how they operate - whether that's building business cases, running research, or finding smarter ways to work a territory. We expect you to bring ideas, not just execute a playbook.

The progression is real. Commercial AEs have moved into Enterprise and into management - and we'll be straight with you about what the path looks like and what it takes to get there.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You've closed deals at a similar size and pace before - $40k–$50k ACV, sub-60-day cycles - and you've got the numbers to back it up.

 - Outbound doesn't feel like a chore to you. You see it as a craft - you build your own lists, think creatively about how to get in front of the right people, and don't rely on a sequence template to do the work for you.

 - You're genuinely curious about what it's like to be an on-call engineer. Not just the technical side - the stress, the 2am pages, the pressure of being the person whose job it is to fix things fast. That empathy shows up in how you sell.

 - You can hold a technical conversation without leaning on your SE every time. You'll have support when you need it, but you're comfortable going deep on your own.

 - You're scrappy in the best sense - you don't wait for resources, you figure it out. A bigger company with more tools, more inbound, and more hand-holding would actually frustrate you.

 - You pick up the phone. Cold calling doesn't make you wince, and a voicemail doesn't derail your afternoon.

 - Startup life genuinely appeals to you - not as a stepping stone, but because you want to be somewhere your work is visible and your impact is real.




SUPPORTING YOU

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

 - Market-leading private medical insurance. The proper kind, so you're never weighing up your health against a bill.

 - Competitive PTO. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

 - First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

 - Enhanced 401k. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

 - Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

 - Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

 - Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

 - Two budgets that have your back. $1000 to invest in your setup, $500 a year to invest in yourself.

jobs.title: Veterinary Hospitalist (Emergency and Critical Care)
jobs.description:
About the Role

Orchard Park Veterinary Medical Center is seeking a Veterinary Hospitalist to lead the care of our hospitalized and ICU patients. The Hospitalist provides continuity of care for critical and complex cases admitted through our emergency service, allowing ER doctors to focus on incoming cases while hospitalized patients receive consistent, dedicated management. This role is ideal for a criticalist or an experienced emergency veterinarian who prefers depth of case management over high-volume intake.

Responsibilities

• Assume primary case responsibility for hospitalized and ICU patients, including rounds, treatment plans, diagnostics, and discharge
• Receive case transfers from overnight and ER doctors and provide structured handoffs at shift change
• Manage critically ill patients, including shock, sepsis, respiratory distress, trauma, toxicities, DKA, AKI, IMHA, and post-operative complications
• Oversee advanced therapies such as transfusion medicine, CRIs, oxygen therapy, and nutritional support [add mechanical ventilation, dialysis, or other capabilities if applicable]
• Communicate daily with clients on patient progress, prognosis, and cost of care, including goals-of-care and end-of-life conversations
• Coordinate with referring veterinarians and in-house or partner specialists on case transfers, updates, and discharge summaries
• Serve as a clinical resource for ER doctors on critical case management
• Mentor and train associate and new graduate veterinarians, and provide ongoing education for the nursing team on ICU protocols and patient monitoring
• Contribute to development of hospital protocols, SOPs, and quality-of-care standards
• Maintain accurate, timely medical records

Required:

• DVM or VMD from an AVMA-accredited institution (or ECFVG/PAVE certification)
• Active veterinary license in [State], or eligibility to obtain one
• Demonstrated experience managing critical and complex hospitalized patients, typically [3+] years in emergency practice
• Strong client communication skills, particularly in high-stakes and emotionally difficult conversations
• Ability to lead and collaborate within a multi-doctor team

Preferred:

• Diplomate of the American College of Veterinary Emergency and Critical Care (DACVECC), or residency-trained in ECC
• Experience mentoring associate veterinarians
• Experience developing clinical protocols or ICU standardsSchedule [Example: Four 10-hour day shifts per week, with rotating weekend coverage.] Primarily day-shift to support case continuity.Compensation and Benefits
• CE allowance and paid CE days
• Professional license and membership dues
• Health, dental, and vision insurance

jobs.description:
AppsFlyer is a cutting-edge technology company that specializes in mobile attribution and marketing analytics. We are known for our rapid deployment of innovative solutions, handling over 150 billion requests daily, focusing on data privacy and scalabilit

The PR&D Analytics & FinOps team helps ensure that product and R&D leadership make data-driven decisions. It supports the organization by connecting critical data aspects, allowing us to see the bigger picture, providing insights, and leading the organization in the right direction.

The PR&D Data Analyst is the technical backbone of the team-  building the data infrastructure and automation that let our FinOps and product/R&D analytics processes run on AI. This role owns the engineering side of our data pipelines end to end, making sure our data is reliable, well-structured, and ready for both human and AI consumption.

What you’ll do

• Build data processes and structures that make the team's data usable and accessible for AI/LLM consumption.

• Own the engineering and infrastructure of all data pipelines across the team's domains: build, run, and maintain them so they're reliable, well-structured, and performant.

• Design and build automations that convert existing team processes across both, FinOps and product/R&D analytics, into AI-based workflows.

• Serve as the technical connector between the FinOps and product/R&D analytics tracks, supporting both with shared, well-engineered data infrastructure.

• Troubleshoot and optimize existing pipelines and automations, proactively identifying points of failure or inefficiency.

• Collaborate closely with analysts on both tracks to understand data needs and translate them into robust solutions.

What you have

• 3-5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a similar hands-on technical data role

• Excellent SQL skills

• Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, dbt, or similar orchestration/transformation tools)

• Experience with BI/visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or similar)

• Hands-on experience working with AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) as part of a daily workflow, and building AI-consumable data structures

• Degree in Industrial Engineering, or a similar field

• Independent, able to juggle multiple technical priorities across domains simultaneously

• All-in approach with high accountability, a sense of ownership, and passion

• Good communication skills - able to work cross-functionally with both FinOps and product/R&D analysts

Bonus points

• Hands on experience with automation tools (such as Make)

• Proficiency in Python/ other programmatic languages for automation and data processing

• Experience with building AI agent-based workflows

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Rolle

Als Accelerator verbindet A11 Europas ambitionierteste Startups, Scaleups, Konzerne und Mittelständler mit Top-Talenten, die echten Impact generieren wollen.

Unser Partner ist ein etablierter Anbieter von Finanz- und Controlling-Software für den Mittelstand: 350+ Mitarbeitende, 100.000+ Nutzer:innen, neues Führungsteam und ein führender europäischer Software-Investor im Rücken. Ein Unternehmen mit Substanz: seit 45 Jahren erfolgreich, profitabel und stabil. Und genau darin liegt die Chance. Mit dem Value-Creation-Plan des Investors beginnt die nächste Wachstumsphase - die Ambition: das Wachstum deutlich beschleunigen, mit Marketing als einem der zentralen Hebel.

Marketing wird hier zum echten Wachstumsmotor, und genau das will die Geschäftsführung: Als Chief Marketing Officer (m/w/d) bekommst du alle Freiheitsgrade, ein entsprechendes Budget und das Mandat, Dinge zu verändern, während du ein Team von rund 10 Kolleg:innen durch die Transformation führst und gemeinsam mit Sales, SDR, RevOps, Product und Customer Experience ein datengetriebenes Marketing Operating Model professionalisierst.

Du berichtest an den Chief Revenue Officer (Teil der Geschäftsführung), der den gesamten Go-to-Market-Bereich von Marketing über Vertrieb bis Customer Success verantwortet und den Wachstumsauftrag mit voller Überzeugung vorantreibt, und gemessen wirst du an Pipeline, Conversion und New ARR statt an Reichweite.

Sei verantwortlich für:

• Ein datengetriebenes Marketing Operating Model mit voller Funnel-Transparenz

• Ein Demand-Generation-System und einen tech-enabled Nurture-Cycle, die messbar in die Neukunden-Pipeline einzahlen

• Schärfung von ICP, Segmentierung und Messaging, gemeinsam mit Sales

• Die enge Verzahnung von Marketing, Product und Sales zu einem durchgängigen Go-to-Market-System

• Führung und Entwicklung des Teams durch den Wandel

• Gesamtverantwortung für Marketing inkl. Product Marketing, Brand und PR, mit klarer Priorität auf Funnel und Pipeline

Dein Profil:

• Mehrjährige Marketing-Leadership-Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS, Software oder angrenzendem tech-enabled B2B

• Nachweisbare Ownership für Demand Generation, Funnel und Pipeline

• Erfahrung beim Aufbau oder Umbau einer Marketingfunktion in einer Wachstumsphase

• Zahlenstark: Attribution, CAC und New ARR sind dein Alltag

• Builder-Mentalität, Resilienz und Tempo: Du kommst schnell von der Analyse in die Wirkung und holst die Organisation mit

• Teamplayer mit klarer Kommunikation, auch lateral auf Augenhöhe mit Sales und SDR

• Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

• Bonus: PE-backed Umfeld, KI-Affinität, Finance-/ERP-Kenntnisse

Du arbeitest hybrid und bist 1-2 Tage pro Woche am Hauptsitz in Bielefeld.

Benefits und Perks:

• Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Transformationsmandat, alle Freiheitsgrade und Budget, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung

• PE-backed Wachstum: klarer Wachstumsplan, Best Practices des Investors und LTI-Beteiligung

• Ein mehrfach ausgezeichneter, stabiler und profitabler Arbeitgeber

Unser Commitment zu Diversity und Inklusion

A11 setzt sich für faire und gleiche Chancen im Recruiting ein, für Bewerber:innen, Kandidat:innen und Mitarbeitende gleichermaßen. Wir schätzen Menschen mit all ihren vielfältigen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen und freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Assistant Controller - Corporate Team
jobs.description:
Primary Job Post

What is #LifeatAF? How can we crystalize its DNA into one eye-catching sentence for you? Our culture is defined by our people! Everyone is an approachable professional, tenacious and versatile, a challenging team member, and a respected and valued mentor.

Do you find numbers so easy that you crunch them in your sleep? Do you have a knack for balancing the FS and income statement? We are looking for you, an out-of-the-box thinker who can deliver on-demand. Come join our world-class finance team and be part of history in the making!

What you’ll do

• Drive month-end and quarter-end consolidated financial close processes and lead flux variance analysis.

• Manage equity and share-based compensation accounting with active involvement across the entire equity lifecycle, including distributions and transactions.

• Oversee day to day complex and high-impact revenue recognition processes under ASC 606 for approximately $600M in annual revenue, ensuring accurate top-line reporting while advancing automation and AI-driven process improvements.

• Prepare consolidated financial statements in strict compliance with US GAAP and SEC standards.

• Work directly with external auditors during quarterly reviews and annual audits to ensure full audit support and PCAOB compliance.

• Analyze financial data to prepare internal reporting packages.

• Support corporate workpaper preparation, tax accounting, lease accounting (ASC 842), and key financial reporting activities.

• Participate in strategic ad-hoc financial initiatives and special corporate projects as needed.ֿ

• Improve accounting and reporting processes by applying AI tools and automation, questioning existing practices, and suggesting practical solutions with broader business needs in mind.

What you have

• Big Four audit background (Hitech sector).

• Deep US GAAP expertise (ASC 606 revenue recognition & equity/SBC) in tech.

• Hands-on financial month-end and year-end close experience.

• Strong internal controls evaluation and remediation skills.

• High attention to detail, precision, and deadline management.

• Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Advanced Excel skills and financial modeling experience.

• Fluent in written and spoken English.

• Strong interpersonal skills and relationship building.

Bonus Points

• Experience with NetSuite ERP software.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer ($200k-$260k + Equity) - NYC
jobs.description:
HEY! WE'RE CONVEO.AI http://Conveo.ai



Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We started this year as a team of ~20 and are on track to reach ~120 people by year end. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

 

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We’re investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.



The engineering team is small and deliberately so. There are no product managers, no designer handoffs, no tickets waiting for someone else to prioritise. Engineers own the full distance from customer problem to working software, and that proximity to the product is exactly what makes this role interesting. You'll report directly to one of our engineering leads, and work incredibly closely with our CTO, Maarten.



Dig deeper into our Engineering/Product ways of working 👉 here  https://engineering.conveo.ai/engineering-at-conveo👈

 
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/49c7399e-a401-4987-ab34-2ca5e18d2f29/82d8d474-2034-4e8c-990c-c2e828853c75/NRP19251.jpg]



WHAT WE'RE BUILDING AND WHY

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

We need a Senior Product Engineer who works backwards from the experience. This is someone who starts with the user's problem, not a spec, and owns everything between that conversation and the code that ships. You shape what gets built, actively contributing to product direction, influencing what we build and how we build it, with real technical and strategic impact.

Own the full stack, from the interface to the infrastructure

Build the interface customers open every day and can't imagine working without. React is the core of what customers see and touch — you lead frontend architecture in React and TypeScript, set the quality bar for components, state management, and performance. And you don't stop there. From API design to cloud infrastructure (AWS), you ship complete, polished features end to end, including AI-powered ones built on LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and async pipelines.

Be the engineering voice in every customer conversation

When a customer has a need, an engineer hears it, interprets it, and solves it. You join customer calls (about once a week), form a clear point of view on what to build, translate feedback into scoped product decisions, and follow through.

Use AI throughout

You reach for agentic solutions first. You use AI to reason, build, review, and test at every stage and you help raise the bar for how the whole team works. Documentation overhead doesn't slow us down here — AI handles that layer, and you're someone who is happy to work that way. You stay current on what frontier models can do and bring that into what we ship.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 6+ years of experience building full-stack applications with TypeScript and Node.js.

 - Strong backend experience: designing APIs, working with PostgreSQL, and managing background jobs and async workflows.

 - Solid frontend skills with React. .

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP) — you're comfortable with services like S3, media pipelines, and deployment tooling.

 - Experience building AI-driven applications (e.g. prompt engineering, working with LLM APIs, and/or fine-tuning experience are a plus).

 - Can independently lead projects from concept to launch.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with a keen eye for detail.

 - A collaborative mindset, able to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced team.


BONUS

 - Experience with React Router v7 or Remix.

 - Experience at a small, fast-moving SaaS company where you’ve been client-facing

 - Exposure to market research or qualitative research tooling.

 - You've shipped agentic AI systems to production and can speak to failure modes, evaluations, and tool design.


WHY JOIN US?

 - Ship alongside engineers who've built and scaled products used by millions.

 - Work directly with frontier AI models and push what they can actually do.

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity. We want you to own a real piece of what we're building.

 - Offices in London, Antwerp, and New York. We work best together, so we ask for 3 days a week in the NYC office.

 - Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more.

 - Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to. Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal.

jobs.title: Enterprise Strategy Partner
jobs.description:
Location: Greater New York City area, with frequent travel to San Francisco, as needed.

Format: In-office 4 days a week with flexibility for the occasional remote days

Base salary: $230,000 – $260,000 annual base pay

Fricative Mission

Businesses make consequential decisions with an incomplete view of the world. What to invest in. Which customers to pursue. Where a market is moving. What risk to take. What to do next.

Their own information is scattered across systems, spreadsheets, conversations, and people’s heads. Meanwhile, public filings, market activity, company announcements, and other outside signals may reveal that something important has changed. People spend enormous amounts of time piecing this together, but the reasoning behind the eventual decision often remains invisible.

Fricative is building toward a Decision Management System: a way to bring those signals together and help a team answer a practical question: What should we do, why, and why now? The answers have to be more than persuasive. People should be able to see where each claim came from, how the evidence fits together, what remains uncertain, and what would change the recommendation. We’re developing this with real clients and real decisions because this is a category that doesn’t have a playbook yet.

Fricative is a portfolio company of super{set}, a venture studio that conceives, funds and builds AI-native companies from formation through scale. We work alongside founders as operators, helping shape companies from day one.

The Role

We're looking for a commercial operator who knows how to get people and organizations moving. You'll work with sophisticated enterprise customers to identify high-value opportunities, build alignment across stakeholders, and turn interest into commercial commitment. You'll need to understand the customer's business, recognize where economic value exists, and navigate competing priorities to move an opportunity forward.

You'll work closely with the AI Solutions Strategist, who diagnoses the underlying problem and develops and tests potential solutions, and the engineers building the system. You own the customer, the commercial opportunity, and the momentum required to move it forward.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

• Find the opportunity. Understand the customer's business, identify where meaningful economic value exists, and establish why solving the problem matters now.

• Build alignment. Navigate stakeholders, competing incentives, and external advisors to get the right people behind an opportunity.

• Drive commercial momentum. Move from initial interest to a clear business case, customer commitment, and commercial engagement.

• Connect customers and solutions. Bring business context and priorities to the Fricative team, keeping the work focused on outcomes the customer values.

• Turn early customer engagements into repeatable ways to identify, win, and expand enterprise opportunities.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first 6–9 months, you will have:

• Built credible relationships with senior stakeholders at target enterprises.

• Advanced meaningful commercial opportunities with a clear business case and path to commitment.

• Created alignment across complex stakeholder groups and kept engagements moving.

• Established repeatable patterns for identifying, winning, and expanding enterprise opportunities.

WHAT YOU BRING

We're looking for someone who combines the structured thinking of a consultant with the commercial instinct and agency to make things happen.

Must Have

• Approximately five years of experience in management consulting, strategy consulting, technology consulting, or a similarly rigorous client-facing role.

• Strong business judgment and the ability to identify economic opportunity and articulate why it matters.

• Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, build alignment, and move decisions forward without formal authority.

• Evidence of turning analysis or recommendations into commitment and action, not just delivering the work.

• Commercial instinct, clear communication, and high personal agency.

• Enough technical curiosity to understand AI-enabled products and connect their potential to business value.

Nice to Have

• Experience in enterprise strategy, technology, data, AI, or transformation.

• Exposure to complex enterprise buying decisions or commercial engagements.

• Experience working across client organizations, technical teams, and external advisors.

What We Look For

We want to see evidence that you can understand a business, recognize an opportunity, and get people moving. Share examples that you can:

• Identify an economic opportunity others have overlooked.

• Influence a senior stakeholder or align people with competing priorities.

• Turn a recommendation into a commitment or concrete action.

This Role Is Probably Not For You If

• You prefer developing recommendations to owning what happens next.

• You prefer maintaining existing relationships to creating new opportunities.

• You want to focus primarily on closing deals without deeply understanding the customer's business.

• You want to diagnose and design the AI solution yourself rather than own the commercial opportunity and customer alignment.

Compensation

USD 230,000 - USD 260,000 annual base salary. The final offer will depend on qualifications, experience and location. This role is also eligible for equity.

The Opportunity

• Help build a new category at the intersection of enterprise decision-making and AI.

• Work directly with sophisticated customers, shape how Fricative goes to market, and help turn an emerging technology into something businesses act on.

• Build a category around a new kind of system for managing how organizations make consequential decisions.

• Partner directly with builders and operators who have repeatedly conceived, built and scaled category-defining infrastructure companies, learning from their pattern recognition while shaping Fricative alongside them.

• Build from an early stage, with the autonomy to create a playbook rather than inherit one.

If you're at your best when the problem is ambiguous, the stakeholders are complicated, and progress depends on you making things move, let's talk.

jobs.title: Scientist, Thermal Analysis
jobs.description:
Join EAG Laboratories as a Scientist specializing in Thermal Analysis and Materials Characterization.

In this role, you will perform hands-on materials characterization, interpret and report high-quality analytical data, and work directly with clients to support real-world technical investigations.

You will discuss thermal and mechanical analysis data and experimental design with clients, connecting analytical results to broader materials, manufacturing, reliability, and product development challenges.

Our clients include leading technology companies, consumer product manufacturers, biotech companies, and aerospace suppliers working in the early phases of product development. Scientists in our Materials Characterization group operate advanced analytical instrumentation and collaborate closely with peers to understand technical problems, determine the appropriate analytical approach, and provide meaningful insight into material behavior and performance.

We are particularly interested in scientists with extensive, multi-year hands-on experience with one or more of the following techniques:

• DMA (Dynamic Mechanical Analysis)
• TMA (Thermomechanical Analysis)
• Rheometry

Experience with additional thermal characterization techniques, including DSC (Differential Scanning Calorimetry) and TGA (Thermogravimetric Analysis), is highly desired, as is experience with other polymer analysis techniques such as GPC (Gel Permeation Chromatography), UV-Vis spectroscopy and FTIR (Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy).

We are looking for scientists who are comfortable managing all stages of the analytical process, including experimental design, sample preparation, selecting and optimizing test conditions, operating and troubleshooting instrumentation, acquiring and interpreting data, and writing technical reports. More importantly, you should be able to look beyond the data itself and explain what the results mean for a client's material, process, or product.

This position requires a strong technical foundation in materials science, polymer science, chemistry, or a related discipline, along with practical experience understanding the thermal, mechanical, viscoelastic, physical and chemical characteristics of materials.

A typical day on the Materials Characterization team may include:

• Processing and interpreting previously acquired thermal or mechanical analysis data and writing technical reports.
• Planning upcoming analyses and determining appropriate testing conditions.
• Preparing samples, setting up instrumentation, and acquiring new data.
• Evaluating thermal transitions, dimensional changes, mechanical response, or rheological behavior based on the analytical technique being used.

In parallel, you may also:

• Participate in internal group meetings to coordinate instrument use and meet client deadlines.
• Speak directly with customers about previous results or questions regarding future analyses.
• Work with EAG's commercial team and customers to understand technical problems and determine how our analytical capabilities can help address them.

You will also likely work on longer-term projects, such as:

• Developing or improving analytical methods for new or challenging materials.
• Producing technical or marketing materials or contributing to scientific papers.
• Working with internal support teams and instrument vendors to troubleshoot and optimize equipment.
• Developing expertise in adjacent materials characterization techniques.

These activities require strong communication and collaboration with your colleagues. You'll often have multiple client projects moving at the same time, so organization, communication, and teamwork are important. This is a fast-moving environment where scientists share expertise, help one another solve problems, and work together to help our clients meet their technical goals. Along the way, you'll also get to do a lot of interesting science.

This position works with companies that deal with defense-related activities and is subject to ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations).

All considered applicants must be U.S. Persons as defined by ITAR: U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. “Green Card Holder”), or Political Asylee or Refuge.

Education and Experience

• M.S. or Ph.D. in Materials Science, Polymer Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Minimum of 3 years of relevant industrial or laboratory experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience with DMA, TMA, and/or rheometry.
• Strong understanding of thermal, mechanical, and/or viscoelastic properties of materials, particularly polymers and polymer-based materials.
• Experience designing experiments, selecting appropriate test conditions, interpreting analytical results, and connecting those results to material properties and performance.
• Experience solving materials-related technical problems and investigating material behavior or performance.
• Experience with instrument operation, method development, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
• Hands-on experience with DSC and/or TGA is highly desirable.
• Prior experience with GPC, UV-Vis and FTIR also desirable
• Experience with other complementary materials characterization techniques is a plus.
• Ability to clearly communicate technical findings through written reports and discussions with clients.

Physical Requirements:

• The person in this position needs to move about inside the office or laboratory to access file cabinets, machinery, equipment etc.
• Ability to continuously operate a personal computer or lab equipment for extended periods of time (4 or more hours).
• Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate a keyboard and other lab equipment, use a telephone, access file cabinets and other items stored at various levels, including overhead.
• Must be able to remain in a stationary position 90% of the time.
• Ability to speak and hear well enough to communicate clearly and understandably with sufficient volume to ensure an accurate exchange of information in normal conversational distance, over the telephone online, and in a group setting.
• Learn new tasks, remember processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, make timely decisions in the context of a workflow, ability to communicate with visitors, ability to complete tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity quota.

The essential physical and mental requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We will consider reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need, we would like to know how we can better accommodate you.

What It’s Like to Work Here:

• Teamwork: Be inspired by your leaders, be encouraged by your teammates and be supported in all parts of your journey while you work with us.
• Learning & Development: Take on career development programs and goal setting to create big possibilities for your career and life. Develop within the company; be mentored and grown as a leader.
• Diversity & Authenticity: We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Benefits & Perks to Foster Work/Life Balance:

✓ Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage

✓ 401k Company Matching

✓ Paid Time Off

✓ Wellness Program

✓ Education Assistance

✓ Volunteer Time Off

✓ …and more!

jobs.title: Senior Field Enablement Manager, Commercial
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.



What You'll Do

We are looking for a Field Sales Enablement Manager to turn our field enablement strategy into repeatable, field-facing execution for the SDR and Commercial Sales organizations. This role owns the day-to-day delivery of onboarding, coaching, and content programs that help SDRs build pipeline, improve prospecting, run effective conversations, and create strong handoffs to Account Executives, and that help Commercial sellers run effective discovery, communicate value, qualify opportunities, and progress deals through close.

You will work closely with the Global Field Enablement and Onboarding Leader, who owns portfolio strategy and leadership alignment. Your role is to keep delivery moving: build and maintain approved assets, run defined workstreams, manage handoffs to specialist partners, and close the loop with adoption data and field feedback.

This is an execution-oriented role for an experienced SDR, SDR leader, Commercial seller, or enablement practitioner who understands SDR and commercial sales workflows, frontline coaching, ramp realities, buyer engagement, and the performance patterns of high-performing teams.



***Please note, this role does require you to come into our downtown Chicago office 3 days a week.***



This role will be responsible for…..

Onboarding execution and program delivery

 - Own the delivery plan for assigned SDR and Commercial Sales workstreams, surfacing risks, dependencies, and capacity implications.

 - Own the operational delivery of SDR and Commercial Sales onboarding programs, including cohort planning, learner communications, completion tracking, content refreshes, and manager-led reinforcement.

 - Contribute an equitable share of responsibilities for recurring sales bootcamp programming as part of the role’s onboarding execution scope. This may include supporting planning and logistics, coordinating invitations and communications, contributing to content, and presenting selected content during bootcamp sessions.

 - Attend each monthly sales bootcamp in person and support the broader Enablement organization through shared bootcamp delivery responsibilities.

 - Build and operate role-based programs that develop proficiency in prospecting, account research, messaging, discovery, qualification, value articulation, objection handling, meeting creation, pipeline generation, SDR-to-AE handoffs, mutual action plans, competitive positioning, and deal progression.

 - Lead defined workstreams such as SDR onboarding, Commercial Sales onboarding, SDR-to-AE career pathway programming, manager onboarding components, role-based onboarding for new or transitioning sellers, and scoped seller or process enablement programs.

 - Serve as program manager or workstream lead for cross-functional programs after scope and stakeholder model are established.



Field coaching

 - Own recurring call-review and coaching operations for SDRs, Commercial sellers, and their frontline managers, including established SDR call-review rhythms.

 - Curate strong call and deal examples, facilitate routine coaching sessions, identify performance patterns, and report actionable insights to SDR and Commercial sales leadership.

 - Coach and reinforce seller behaviors across prospecting, personalization, messaging, discovery, qualification, value articulation, objection handling, meeting quality, pipeline creation, stakeholder engagement, mutual close plans, and forecast discipline.

 - Partner with SDR and Commercial frontline managers to reinforce consistent coaching practices, operating expectations, and manager-led reinforcement.

 - Support Gong scorecard rollout and reporting in partnership with the Field Enablement and Onboarding Leader, Head of Global Enablement, and Enablement Ops.



Content and asset maintenance

 - Draft field inputs, coordinate reviews, QA, publish, and maintain SDR and Commercial Sales enablement assets, including prospecting playbooks, messaging guides, call frameworks, discovery frameworks, value messaging, objection-handling resources, talk tracks, battlecards, proof-point libraries, onboarding materials, and manager guides.

 - Partner with Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Technical Enablement, Deal Desk, and SDR and Commercial sales leadership to keep assets aligned to each sales motion and current field needs.

 - Lead scoped efforts such as tool and workflow audits, SDR career-pathway content, enablement requirements for prospecting and conversation-intelligence platforms, Partner 101 coordination, technology-enablement discovery, and Deal Desk or process-module requirements gathering.

 - Own contained content updates, tool-module coordination, and specialist follow-up so leaders are not the default builders or first responders.



Request intake, routing, and measurement

 - Validate incoming requests, gather missing inputs, maintain the backlog, and prepare routing recommendations.

 - Before routing approved work to specialists, prepare a clear brief covering the business problem, audience, desired seller behavior, priority, deadline, SME and approver, source materials, and definition of done.

 - Route instructional-design work to Spencer McKee, technology and platform work to Katie Lopes, and technical-product work to Merys Raymer, then manage projects through launch.

 - Maintain feedback collection, post-launch reviews, adoption reporting, and monthly status updates for assigned workstreams.



What success looks like

Within the first 90 days, you will have:

 - Taken ownership of SDR and Commercial Sales onboarding execution, bootcamp contribution planning, call-review operations, backlog hygiene, content-refresh coordination, and stakeholder status updates.

 - Assessed the SDR and Commercial sales motions and established an enablement plan for the highest-impact behaviors, including prospecting, messaging, discovery, qualification, value articulation, objection handling, meeting quality, pipeline creation, and deal progression.

 - Established a reliable operating rhythm for onboarding, recurring bootcamp contribution, routine coaching, content maintenance, learner communications, and adoption reporting.

 - Advanced priority SDR and Commercial enablement workstreams, launched scoped modules through specialist partners, and built a quarterly refresh calendar with clear ownership across priority work.



What You’ll Bring

 - Sales experience path: 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B sales experience, including experience as a Commercial, SMB, Mid-Market, or comparable Account Executive, plus 2+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales leadership, program management, sales operations, or a related field, including managing multiple timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders.

 - Sales enablement experience path: 5+ years of sales enablement and onboarding experience supporting Commercial or Mid-Market sellers, with demonstrated ownership and delivery of onboarding, coaching, content, or other field enablement programs.

 - Demonstrated success selling SaaS, cybersecurity, or technical solutions with multiple buyer personas, or equivalent experience enabling teams that sell these solutions.

 - Strong field-facing facilitation and coaching skills, with the credibility to coach Commercial sellers and partner effectively with frontline managers.

 - Experience partnering with sales leaders to translate pipeline needs, performance patterns, and sales-process gaps into practical enablement programs.

 - Ability to coordinate work clearly across Enablement, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and other relevant stakeholders while protecting field relevance and adoption.

 - Comfort operating without formal authority, building trust, managing handoffs, and escalating risks or decisions appropriately.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear briefs, status updates, coaching feedback, and seller-facing messaging.


What Sets You Apart?

 - Sales experience path: 5+ years of combined experience as an SDR or BDR, SDR leader or manager, or quota-carrying B2B Account Executive (Commercial, SMB, Mid-Market, or comparable), with firsthand understanding of prospecting, qualification, pipeline creation, ramp, performance management, and deal progression. This path also requires 2+ years of experience in sales enablement, program management, sales operations, sales leadership, or a related field, including managing multiple timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders.

 - Sales enablement experience path: 5+ years of sales enablement and onboarding experience supporting SDR, Commercial, or Mid-Market sellers, with demonstrated ownership and delivery of onboarding, coaching, content, or other field enablement programs.

 - Strong field-facing facilitation and coaching skills, with the credibility to coach SDRs and Commercial sellers and partner effectively with frontline managers.

 - Experience partnering with SDR and sales leaders to translate pipeline needs, performance patterns, and sales-process gaps into practical enablement programs that reinforce consistent seller behaviors.

 - Ability to coordinate work clearly across Enablement, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and other relevant stakeholders while protecting field relevance and adoption.

 - Comfort operating without formal authority, building trust, managing handoffs, and escalating risks or decisions appropriately.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear briefs, status updates, coaching feedback, and seller-facing messaging.



Travel Required

This role may require up to 20% travel for internal offsites and sales team alignment.

 

Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range $142,000 - $160,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

We mean that we offer a great flexible schedule that offers the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever. Even if you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

You should possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings.

.

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.
Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.
Prepare product.
Receive and process telephone orders.
Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Orientation and training provided on the job.

jobs.title: Line Cook (08181) - 6400 N HWY 349
jobs.description:
Domino’s Line Cooks are dedicated to food safety and proper handling of the products used to cook a customer’s perfect meal. Line Cooks must be able to work in a fast-paced time pressured environment and be able to adjust as the needs of the business shifts. Line Cooks ensure that all products are made to Domino’s Specifications.

To be successful as a Line Cook, you should be a committed, communicative team player with excellent time management skills. You should be able to prioritize tasks in a busy setting and adhere to all food safety regulations and procedures.

Line Cook Responsibilities:

• Ensure all food safety guidelines are followed.
• Know Domino’s recipes and specs.
• Check makeline and cut table for readiness at beginning of each shift.
• Check all temperatures of refrigeration units and bins.
• Understand the importance of time restraints and be able to work swiftly for 2-4 hours at a time.
• Properly portion and itemize products in accordance with Domino’s Standards.
• Properly Dock and Stretch dough in accordance with Domino’s Standards.
• Work in an assembly line configuration.
• Re-Date all products moved to in-use status.
• Communicate with other station team members on needs.
• Maintain sanitation and cleanliness of makeline and cut table.
• Restock makeline bins and cabinets as business allows/needs.
• Check quality of each product during bake and during boxing for accuracy with Domino’s specs.
• Report any hazards and maintenance needs.

Line Cook Requirements:

• Minimal work experience. 1 year restaurant experience a plus
• Strong problem solving and communication skills.
• Texas Certified Food Handlers Certificate required.
• Exceptional time management skills.
• Able to read a computer screen
• Able to memorize topping and product codes.
• Able to stand or walk for 8-10 hour shifts and lift at least 30 pounds.
• Show pride and accuracy in work
• Willing to comply with all food safety procedures.
• Detail-oriented and hard working

Education and Experience

A high school diploma or equivalent degree is a plus but not required. Candidates for this position do not need prior experience as relevant training is provided on the job in order to learn employer-specific functions such as how to operate the computer system and to learn information about menu items. Sales experience is a plus. Customer service experience does help when greeting customers, answering potential inquiries, and handling complaints, though this also is not required.

Work Environment

A Domino’s Line Cook prepares a large volume of product over every shift, which can be taxing. Standing for long periods of time while assembling pizzas and other products is expected, which may contribute to back strain and foot problems. Because we are working with food, frequent hand sanitization is another expectation. The environment is warm, bustling, and potentially noisy. The environment of a Domino’s restaurant is populated by triple stack conveyor belt ovens, multiple warming shelves and carts on wheels which can lead to injury.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Prep Cook (09341) - 1003 N. Sycamore
jobs.description:
Domino’s Prep Cooks are dedicated to food safety and proper handling of the products used to cook a customer’s perfect meal. Prep Cooks must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and be able to adjust as the needs of the business shifts. Prep Cooks ensure that everything the line cooks need, when they need it, is ready to go, organized, dated, and rotated.
To be successful as a Prep Cook, you should be a committed, communicative team player with excellent time management skills. You should be able to prioritize tasks in a busy setting and adhere to all food safety regulations and procedures.

Prep Cook Responsibilities:

• Ensuring all food safety guidelines are followed.
• Receiving trucks deliveries checking in all products and examining them for any damage or missing goods.
• Dating, Rotating, and storing all products received on same day of delivery.
• Pulling data each day for prepping needs for a 48 hour period.
• Prepping all products according to Domino’s Standards.
• Proofing dough for a 24 hour period, dating and re-cooling.
• Maintaining proper temperature of products while prepping.
• Checking Temperatures of all refrigeration units
• Dating all products according to Domino’s dating standards.
• Prepping all cooking PRP’s. Includes Sandwich mats and Papered pans.
• Maintaining Sanitation of prep area and any where food may be exposed to.
• Restocking dipping cups, soda machine(s) and boxes.
• Reporting any safety hazards and maintenance needs.

Prep Cook Requirements:

• Minimal work experience. 1 year restaurant experience a plus
• Strong problem solving and communication skills.
• Texas Certified Food Handlers Certificate required.
• Exceptional time management skills.
• Ability to stand or walk for 8-10 hour shifts and lift at least 30 pounds.
• Shows pride in work
• Willingness to comply with all food safety procedures.
• Detail-Oriented

Education and Experience
A high school diploma or equivalent degree is a plus but not required. Candidates for this position do not need prior experience as relevant training is provided on the job in order to learn employer-specific functions such as how to operate the computer system and to learn information about each product. A positive attitude is a must.
Work Environment
A Domino’s Prep Cook preps a large volume of products every shift, which can be taxing. Standing for long periods of time is expected, which may contribute to back strain and foot problems. Because Prep cooks are handling food, frequent hand sanitization is another expectation. The environment is warm, bustling, and potentially noisy. The environment of a Domino’s restaurant is populated by triple stack conveyor belt ovens, multiple warming shelves and carts on wheels which can lead to injury.

jobs.title: Customer Service Rep(07709) - 2160 BIRCH RD
jobs.description:
Job Duties
• Operate all equipment. • Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler. • Prepare product. • Receive and process telephone orders. • Take inventory and complete associated paperwork. • Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.
Training
Orientation and training provided on the job.
Communication Skills
Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions. Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.
Essential Functions/Skills
Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed. Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.
Work Conditions
EXPOSURE TO: Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks. In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas. Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside. Fumes from food odors. Exposure to cornmeal dust. Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler. Hot surfaces/tools from over up to 500 degrees or higher. Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.
SENSING: Talking and hearing on the telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks. Depth perception. Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.
TEMPERMENTS: The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work along and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.
STANDING: Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile “bricks” with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36” and 48”.
WALKING: Walking is generally in short distances for short durations.
Delivery personnel must travel between the store and the delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer’s location.
SITTING: Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or
table.
LIFTING: Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck. Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3’ x 1.5’. Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacking onto shelves up to 72” high.
CARRYING: Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves. Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried form the storage room to the front of the store. Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.
During delivery, carry pizzas, sides, and beverages while performing “walking” and “climbing” duties.
DRIVING: Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A team member may make several deliveries per shift.
PUSHING: Pushing is performed to move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24”-30” and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push. Trays may also be pulled.
CLIMBING: Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.
During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of
stairs may be required.
STOOPING/BENDING: Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station. Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station. Duration of this position is approximately 40-45 seconds at a time, repeated continuously during the day. Forward bending is also present at the front counter when stocking ingredients.
CROUCHING/SQUATTING: Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.
REACHING: Reaching is performed continuously; up, down, and forward. Workers reach above 72” occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves. Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes. Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.
HAND TASKS: Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day. Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists. Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing a pizza from an the oven., and when using the rolling cutter. Frequent
and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes. Team members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

MACHINE, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT, WORK AIDS: Team members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel

jobs.title: Manager in Training (MIT)(06197) - 7959 Kings Hwy
jobs.description:
Our MIT (Manager in Training) program is for all of our team leaders in the store. This can range from anyone finishing up school and ready to start in management, to someone with years of management experience and ready to join our team with Dominos. The MIT training program has been providing the future leaders of Domino's Pizza the necessary tools and training to be highly effective Domino's Managers This broad position allows most inside team members to fit in somewhere in the program and allows them to advance their skills. Most of our inside help will be filled with this position.

The MIT program clearly outlines an advancement path for our team members to move up in the company. Each step of the program will come with new responsibilities and higher pay so everyone has new skills to work towards. This path can lead to a General Manager position where you lead your own store. We encourage all inside team members to advance through this path.

Progressing through the MIT program can go as quickly or as slow as you'd like. Online training and in-classroom training classes are available to team members for skills advancement. We perform periodic evaluations to assess your progress and offer guidance on what can be improved to advance to the next position and pay scale. These evaluations are also where team members can earn raises or promotions that they have worked towards. This ensures everyone has clear guidelines and direction to advance their career with us.

Many of our team members began their careers as Delivery Drivers, Customer Service Representatives, and Assistant Managers and today are successful General Managers, Supervisors, and even Domino's franchise owners! Our stores offer a world of opportunity for anyone willing to step up!

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you have always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance, Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically Assistant Managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills- judgement, math and the ability to multi-task.

Qualifications

Experienced managers in training are responsible for everything that happens during their shift. This includes cost control, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You set the tone and the example for the store and you have to be on your game 100% of the time!

Your job responsibilities would include (but are not limited to):

• Perform all the duties of the Customer Services Representatives and Delivery Drivers.
• Manage anywhere from 3 to 30 employees during your scheduled shift.
• Responsible for all store operations.
• Greeting customers and taking orders with a smile (yes, you even have to smile when you answer the phone)!
• Operating the cash register and collecting payment from customers.
• Making fast, accurate and consistent products while complying with all portion sizes, recipes and baking procedures.
• Delivering product by vehicle from the store to the customer in a safe and courteous manner.
• Maintaining cleanliness of the restaurant from the first thing the customer sees all the way to the back of the store.
• Maintain a professional appearance at all times in compliance within the Domino's Pizza Grooming Standards.

What are we looking for?

The good news is we can teach you how to answer the phone and make a perfect pizza. But here are a few skills you should have to be a successful Assistant Manager:

• Experience leading a team; during your shift, you will manage a staff of anywhere from 3 to 30 people. You will need to use your stellar attitude and motivational skills to get them in the right place, at the right time and doing the right thing all while creating a great place to work.
• A great role model - you're the person everyone will look to. From being on time for your shift, to having a great attitude to customers and co-workers and even how you dress - you have to have high standards for yourself and the rest of the team.
• You have to be at least 17 years old.

You'll be working for a company that is fun and flexible. Not to mention, its work experience you will rely on for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now it's time to help up be the pizza delivery company in the world. Go on, boss, show us what you've got.  We offer bi-weekly pay. Apply now!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
