•     Accountable: Takes accountability for making their own decisions linked to their own deliverables. Involves senior members to discuss their plan of actions and key decisions at the right time.
•     Collaborate: Actively seeks out others' opinions and input and is open-minded to their views. Challenges others appropriately and is also open to being challenged on their own views.

•     Problem Solve: Accurately assesses a situation to find the best solution or way of working in order to resolve the issues. Is focused on creating a long term fix rather than a short-term solution.

•     Develop and implement commissioning strategies, execution plans, test procedures, and work packages for complex I&C systems, and support CSU schedule development and workforce planning.
•     Review engineering deliverables, control narratives, logic diagrams, P&IDs, network architecture drawings, instrument datasheets, and equipment documentation, and participate in system boundary development, turnover planning, and startup sequence development.
•     Lead construction completion walkdowns, verify system readiness for turnover, and validate installation against approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
•     Manage punch list identification, prioritization, resolution, and closeout, and coordinate turnover from construction to commissioning and startup organizations.
•     Lead commissioning, functional testing, loop checks, calibration verification, and startup activities for Distributed Control Systems (DCS), PLC and SCADA systems, Building Automation Systems (BAS), Life Safety Systems (LSS), control valves, instrumentation and analyzers, and industrial communication networks.
•     Support energization, startup, and operational testing activities, and coordinate multi-discipline testing involving mechanical, electrical, process, and facilities systems.
•     Troubleshoot instrumentation, controls, software, communication, and integration issues.
•     Prepare and review commissioning procedures, test packages, turnover certificates, and startup documentation, including System Turnover Packages (STOs) and Mechanical Completion Certificates (MCCs), verifying completion, quality, and compliance with project quality requirements.
•     Coordinate OEM factory representatives during equipment startup and testing, interface with construction contractors and specialty subcontractors to resolve field issues, and support client witnessing and acceptance testing requirements.
•     Promote a zero-incident safety culture, support implementation of LOTO procedures, participate in Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) reviews, and ensure compliance with project EHS requirements.

Education and Experience Requirements:

•     Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline and 2-5 years of relevant experience or 6-9 years of relevant work experience in mission critical facilities.

Required Knowledge and Skills:

•     Ability to review and interpret P&IDs, control narratives, instrument loop drawings, logic diagrams, network architecture drawings, and vendor documentation.
•     Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Modbus, BACnet, Profinet, and OPC.
•     Knowledge of various control systems and equipment to include Distributed Control Systems (DCS), Building Management Systems (BMS), Life Safety Systems (LSS), Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), control valves, instruments, and transmitters.

jobs.title: Shift Electrical Technician

We are the world’s largest producer of sustainable wood pellets, which provide a low-carbon alternative to fossil fuels.

The Electrical Technician assists with the electrical team's understanding of the production process and leads troubleshooting and repair of electrical, controls, and some mechanical aspects of production and facilities equipment on assigned shifts. This position provides technical support to Production team members, analyzes production data, and improves safety, uptime, quality, energy consumption, tool change cycle times, and other operational metrics.

Merrill Wealth Management is a leading provider of comprehensive wealth management and investment products and services for individuals, companies, and institutions. Merrill Wealth Management is one of the largest businesses of its kind in the world specializing in goals-based wealth management, including planning for retirement, education, legacy, and other life goals through investment advice and guidance.

Merrill's Financial Advisors and Wealth Management Client Associates help clients pursue the life they envision through a personal relationship with their advisory team committed to their needs. Merrill is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development.  Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Merrill, we empower you to bring your whole self to work. We value the unique perspectives in our thoughts, business, and within our employees and clients. Our Wealth Management team represents an array of different skills and experiences that individuals bring from all backgrounds and careers; whether gained through military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce  and positively impact the communities we serve.

The Advisor Development Program is designed for individuals excited to make a career transition and follow their passion of becoming a Financial Advisor.

Job Description:

The Wealth Management Client Associate - Advisor Development Program (WMCA - ADP) role is an entry role into our Advisor Development Program where the destination role is becoming a full-scale Financial Advisor at Merrill. This progression role is responsible for providing client service support to Financial Advisors (FAs).

As a WMCA - ADP your journey begins by obtaining your Securities Industry licenses, where you will receive dedicated study time for your Securities Industry Essentials [SIE], Series 7, and Series 66 Exams.  Your SIE, Series 7 & 66 must be obtained within 120 days; (63 & 65 accepted, in lieu of 66, if previously held). Once you obtain your licenses, you will be taught the foundational skills needed to be a WMCA - ADP.

This job is responsible for providing client service support to multiple FAs.  Key responsibilities include supporting enterprise strategic objectives, operational excellence goals, and client advocacy within the FA's business, while customizing solutions based on their specific needs. Job expectations include serving as the most frequent point of contact within Merrill to address all service needs of their clients and acting as a resource for FAs on the team.

Once you have reached your key milestones, including proficiency in your current role and the completion of experiential activities showcasing your ability to become an advisor, you will then progress into the next stage of the Advisor Development Program, beginning building a book of business as a Financial Advisor trainee.  You will complete dedicated training preparing you for this role and once complete you will continue to work in a Merrill office where you will be acquiring, building, and managing client relationships while considering a client's complex financial picture and guiding them with advice and solutions.

Once you complete your performance requirements as a Financial Advisor trainee you will reach the ultimate destination of becoming a Merrill Financial Advisor. You will be supported along the way with dedicated programs, tools, and resources throughout your career journey.

The Advisor Development Program consists of progressive roles to ultimately become a Merrill Financial Advisor.  Our progressive roles in the Advisor Development Program engage in:

•   Developing a book of business in order to meet and exceed established performance hurdles

•   Effectively prioritizing and sourcing prospective clients, capitalizing on referrals, assessing customer needs, referring customers to the appropriate internal specialists, and executing highly customized solutions to meet client needs

•   Recommending investment products and services that are suitable for prospects based on their objectives, resources, time horizon, risk profile and preferences

•   Balancing investment growth, referral activities, customer follow up, prospect building, administrative compliance and personal growth and development according to both a day-to-day and longer-term planning

•   Organizing and managing resources (time, people, budget) to run a productive practice

•   Seeking the expertise of specialists, where appropriate, to identify planning and investment strategies for a client

•   Completing mandated training, assessments, performance goals and continuing education requirements

We'll help you

•   Build a successful career at Bank of America through world-class training and on-boarding programs that set you up for success.

•   Get training and one-on-one coaching from our-award winning Academy at Bank of America and local leadership who are invested in your success.

•   Grow your business knowledge by using a defined consultative approach to systematically identify client needs and appropriate solutions.

•   Provide end-to-end comprehensive advice, deliver client reviews/presentations with confidence and recommend strategies to help achieve their financial goals and life priorities.

•   Collaborate with core banking and investment partners. Connect to all the solutions we provide through Bank of America and Merrill to meet virtually all their financial needs.

Required Qualifications:

•   Builds strong client relationships through effective communication and collaboration

•   Demonstrates a results-driven growth mindset and prioritizes client interests

Desired Qualifications:

Job Responsibilities:

•   Partners with Financial Advisors, Client Relationship Managers, and Market Supervision Managers on all aspects of client servicing, risk, investments, and banking products, while receiving appropriate guidance and escalating issues as needed•

•   Provides excellent Client Service to the bank's clients through educating them on all of the bank's service and banking offerings•

Accelerate your career today by supporting public sector organizations as a Technical Business Analyst.

The Technical Business Analyst is responsible for supporting the implementation of solutions and identifies/analyzes customer business requirements, assesses the effective use of technology, and makes recommendations regarding process solutions. Identify core business needs, document concepts of operation, briefings, and user stories, document business rules, and construct workflow diagrams, create as-is and future state process maps, and provide gap analysis as needed in an Agile environment.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

•    Serve as a primary point of contact for development and lead project/implementation engagements in an agile environment.

•    Facilitate requirements elicitation using interviews, requirements meetings, surveys, document analysis, site visits, use case and workflow analysis.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology or a related field or college level coursework or equivalent combination of education/experience and experience in analyzing, designing, testing, and documenting production systems.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You’ll Do

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to own and scale the systems, processes, and data foundation that power Horizon3's go-to-market engine. This role sits at the center of Marketing, Sales, and RevOps, turning strategy into measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

You'll be a strategic operator and a hands-on builder. You will own the architecture and roadmap for our marketing tech stack, lead complex cross-functional projects from problem definition through rollout, and set the standards for how campaigns are built, tracked, and measured. You will work with a high degree of independence and be the person the team brings the hard problems to.

 

Marketing Systems & Technology

 - Maintain and support the day-to-day operations and functional health of the marketing automation platform and its Salesforce integration, assisting with updates to segmentation, scoring, routing, nurturing, lifecycle workflows, and compliance tasks (GDPR, CCPA, etc.).

 - Assist in the evaluation, research, and rollout of new GTM tech stack tools, including supporting business case development, coordinating vendor logistics, and facilitating implementation steps for the team.

 - Conduct routine audits, testing, and troubleshooting across the marketing tech stack to identify inefficiencies and help implement technical fixes designed by cross-functional leads.

 - Execute data governance protocols to ensure data accuracy and consistency remain aligned across all integrated systems.

 - Flag funnel conversion and handoff problems and drive the fixes across teams.



Campaign Operations

 - Support campaign managers with program setup, pre-launch QA, and tracking validation to help ensure timely multi-channel launches.

 - Help facilitate the day-to-day execution of ABM programs, assisting with account list uploads, segmentation updates, tool configuration, and reporting pulls.

 - Monitor operational workflows for bottlenecks and assist the Senior Strategic Program Manager in deploying process tweaks that improve efficiency and accuracy.



Process, Automation & AI

 - Support the maintenance and optimization of systems and automations that reduce manual work and help keep marketing data clean and actionable.

 - Assist in researching and implementing AI agents or automated workflows identified by team leads to replace manual processes.

 - Track emerging marketing technologies and AI tooling, sharing relevant insights and research with leadership to inform future recommendations.

 - Maintain comprehensive documentation for workflows, SOPs, and system configurations, and support end-user training and enablement for the marketing team.

 - Provide peer guidance and onboarding support to analysts and marketing operations teammates as needed.



Analytics & Reporting

 - Partner with the Senior Marketing Analytics Manager on attribution, dashboards, and metric definitions, and make sure the systems capture what reporting needs.

 - Monitor marketing data quality and troubleshoot issues across the GTM stack (Pardot, Salesforce, Chili Piper, etc.).

 - Support attribution modeling and lead scoring initiatives.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Serve as an operations partner to Demand Generation, Sales, Finance, RevOps, and IT.

 - Align cross-functionally on goals, definitions, and processes across the funnel.



What You’ll Bring

 - 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, or a related role in B2B SaaS or technology.

 - Expert, hands-on experience with marketing automation and Salesforce, including administering integrations between them.

 -  Track record of leading complex, cross-functional systems projects end to end, such as a lifecycle redesign, a scoring and routing overhaul, a platform migration, or an attribution rollout.

 - Deep understanding of lead lifecycle management, scoring, routing, segmentation, and campaign tracking.

 - Strong background in data management, analytics, and performance reporting.

 - Experience operationalizing account-based marketing programs.

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate workflows, solve problems, and improve team efficiency.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building processes where none exist.

 - Able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and get to a decision.

 - Detail-oriented with a bias for action. You deliver accurate work quickly and own QA.



What Sets You Apart?

 - Experience with the wider GTM stack, such as Chili Piper, Zuddl, RevSure, Nooks, Peerbound, Gainsight, Clay, Influ2, or Reachdesk.

 - Familiarity with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) or working SQL.

 - Experience in cybersecurity, highly technical B2B markets, or enterprise go-to-market motions.



What Success Looks Like

 - Marketing data is accurate, trusted, and consistently used in decision-making.

 - Systems and processes scale as the business grows, with a roadmap the team can see.

 - Day-to-day marketing workflows run smoothly, and campaign owners launch faster with fewer errors.

 - Campaign and funnel performance is transparent, measurable, and clearly tied to revenue outcomes.



Travel Required

This role may require minimal travel for internal offsites. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

 

Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $145,000 - $185,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 



Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

Stratolaunch is seeking a subject matter expert in Mechanical Systems to join the Technical Staff in Engineering. Members of the Technical Staff at Stratolaunch are the company’s foremost functional area experts, providing company-level technical leadership as they solve today’s execution problems and develop innovative solutions for the future. The successful candidate will have demonstrated technical leadership capability and a track record applying deep technical expertise in aerospace structures, mechanical design, kinematics, material selection, structural analysis methods, as well as familiarity with engineering drawings, aerospace manufacturing methods, FEA analysis, and test data interpretation to solve practical engineering problems.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide company-level technical discipline leadership in technical review, technical mentorship, mechanical problem solving, and conceptual design

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. • In-depth experience in the following:

• Aerospace structures

• Kinematics

• Material selection methods

• Engineering drawings and documentation

• Structural analysis methods

• Aerospace manufacturing methods

• Test planning and test data interpretation

• Demonstrated ability as a technical leader

• Demonstrated ability applying technical expertise to solve high-impact problems

• Demonstrated experience applying analytical and critical thinking skills to solve multi-disciplinary, open-ended engineering problems

• Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment to achieve business goals

• Working knowledge of systems engineering principles and best practices, especially relating to requirements verification through test Experience owning and implementing technical roadmaps Experience supporting hypersonic vehicle development programs culminating in flight testing Active DOW security clearance

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

• Senior Principal ($168,450-$299,210): Bachelor’s degree, Master’s or Doctoral degree (graduate degree preferred) in related discipline from an accredited institution and 20+ years relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and experience

The Dental Front Office Receptionist (DFOR) is responsible for providing excellent customer service while performing front office duties for the NATIVE HEALTH clinics. This includes greeting patients in a positive and friendly manner, answering all incoming phone calls, appointment setting, updating patient information, verifying eligibility for the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) or other patient payment sources, payment collection, payment processing, and other clerical duties. The Dental Receptionists work as a team and are principally responsible for the first contact with patients to ensure optimal patient flow.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

• Provide excellent customer service to visitors, patients, and staff in person and on the phone.
• Manages patient registration and eligibility for insurance.
• Connecting the uninsured and underinsured with enrollment services.
• Manages dental appointments and provider's schedules.
• Collect and process accurate payments from individual patients.
• Supports the organization as needed.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Excellent customer service skills.
• Expert knowledge regarding eligibility requirements of AHCCCS, CMDP, Sliding Fee Scale Program, and Title V.
• General Knowledge of dental terminology including American Dental Association Current Dental Terminology (CDT) codes.
• Knowledge of general office procedures including answering telephone calls, directing calls, photocopying, faxing, typing, Microsoft Office programs including Excel, Word, and Outlook, etc.
• Ability to use medical Electronic Health Records: Nextgen.
• Knowledge of privacy and confidentiality policies and regulations.
• Ability to work with people and to make them comfortable about the release of personal, financial, and medical information.
• Ability to communicate and engage others to carry out assignments, meet goals, and ensure the success of NATIVE HEALTH.
• Ability to confirm private insurance benefits and determine associated co-pay requirements.
• Possess a positive attitude.
• Must be able to work with confidential information and materials without betraying the trust of client/family and NATIVE HEALTH

Qualification/Experience:

• High school diploma required.
• Associate degree preferred.
• A Minimum of one year of experience in dental front office. 3 years of combined experience in customer service or other direct medical or dental care experience is preferred.
• Bilingual in Spanish is preferred.
• Must be 25 years of age and insurable by NATIVE HEALTH liability auto policy.

Standard employment requirements:

• Must possess a valid and unrestricted Arizona driver’s license (within 30 days of hire if applicant is from out-of-state) with no DUI/DWI or reckless driving convictions in the last five years. No more than two at-fault accidents in the last three years. Must maintain a valid Arizona driver’s license during employment. Must be insurable under NATIVE HEALTH’s liability auto policy.
• Must pass a criminal background check and obtain a Class I Fingerprint Clearance Card within the initial ninety (90) calendar days of employment and retain a valid card while employed with NATIVE HEALTH.
• Must pass substance abuse testing upon employment and submit to random testing during employment.
• Must provide an updated immunization (IZ) record at the time of employment.
• Must have a current (within 12 months) Tuberculosis (TB) skin report upon employment and provide an annual update.
• Must obtain Basic Life Support (BLS) certification within (90) calendar days of employment and maintain certification during employment.

Native Health complies with all state and federal requirements, including EEOC requirements.

jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) is a key position to support our employees throughout the business or functions that they support and will bring an energetic, diligent and empathetic mindset. The HRBP is responsible (with the support of management) for the implementation and coordination of the organization’s human resource strategies in their scope of responsibilities. The HRBP anticipates, manages and delivers services to our employees in the areas of recruitment, training and development, performance management, employee relations, compliance, and employee recognition. All HRBP works in collaboration with our HR Center of Excellence (Talent Management, HR Operations, Total Rewards, DE&I and other HR Partners to deliver exceptional customer service to the business.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Serves as the HR subject matter expert to managers and employees and establishes HR as a credible and trustworthy resource.
• Collaborate closely with leaders to understand their goals, challenges, and workforce needs. Provide strategic counsel and recommendations on HR initiatives that support the achievement of business objectives.
• Ensures HR is providing customer-oriented service to the business including talent management and organizational effectiveness, supports onboarding, employee relations, conflict management, termination, etc.
• Serve as a subject matter expert on employee relations matters, including policy interpretation, conflict resolution, and performance management. Provide guidance and coaching to managers on handling complex employee relations issues.
• Ensure compliance with labor laws, regulations, and company policies. Identify and mitigate potential risks related to HR practices, and implement proactive measures to address them.
• Fosters a positive, diverse and inclusive culture through education, communication, and initiatives. Facilitates performance management through coaching, systems and processes.
• Develops and coordinates learning and development plans to transfer knowledge and provide career growth.
• Conducts investigations of workplace policy violations and mediates difficult employee relations issues.
• Facilitate change management processes, and support the implementation of organizational restructuring or transformation initiatives.
• Analyze HR data and metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
• Participate in all other Human Resources activities with the HR Leadership team.
• Other duties as assigned by management.

Work Environment:

• As a hybrid role, this position can be based out of the Veolia’s office.
• Typical office environment including heavy computer usage and sitting for long periods of time.
• A fast-paced, varied environment is expected with this position.

Education/Experience/Background:

• Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline required.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Success
jobs.description:
ABOUT US


Medical data exchange is one of the biggest unsolved problems in US healthcare. If you've spent any real time in the healthcare system, you've felt it, and it only gets worse the sicker and older you get. Metriport exists to fix that. We connect to the data sources the healthcare providers of tomorrow need, take raw data that's unusable in its source form, and turn it into a single clean format that care teams, and their agents, actually use to improve outcomes. Record retrieval across thousands of legacy systems and antiquated data pipes that used to take weeks now takes seconds. Clinicians walk into appointments with the full patient picture already in hand, and that speed can mean spotting a condition early enough to actually treat it.

We're not a healthcare company. We're a technology company that happens to operate in healthcare, and we build every layer ourselves: connect, transform, and insight. Legacy EHRs were built to get providers paid, not to serve the clinical experience. We're building what should have existed instead: the system of record for all of US healthcare. We started in data exchange. Today we compete with the largest data platforms in the space. Tomorrow we will be the infrastructure layer healthcare runs on.

We’ve raised $28.4 million from top-tier VCs (including Matrix, ARTIS and Y Combinator), found product-market fit (multi-million dollar ARR, 100+ customers including Amazon One Medical, Circle Medical, Color Health, and Strive Health), and have years of runway ahead of us. If you’ve had a good healthcare experience in the past few years, there’s a good chance Metriport was behind it. That’s the version of healthcare we want people to not just expect, but demand. Join us and build the future.



ABOUT YOU


We're a small, high-output team, mostly former founders including YC alumni, and we operate with real autonomy and almost no bureaucracy. We hire on competence, not pedigree. Leaders are in the office six days a week, and we generally expect the team to be available six days a week too. Not because we count hours, but because there's always more wood to chop when revolutionizing how tomorrow’s healthcare providers deliver care to their patients today. We trust our team to take the time off they need and we've never said no to a time off request.

You have an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong sense of ownership. You don't wait to be told what's broken. Instead, you believe you can figure out any problem that lands in your lap even outside your exact domain. When someone scopes something for three weeks, you ask why it can't be done in three days, and you also know the difference between shipping a fast v0 and cutting a corner that comes back to bite you. You walk the tightrope between craft and speed without falling off either side.

 - Customer Obsessed: When we say “obsessed”…we mean it.

 - Experience: You’ve been at the helm of the ship, growing customer success from 1 to 100 at an early stage startup selling a very technical product to customers. You’re eager to do it again.

 - Problem Solving: You identify opportunities when others see problems. You can quickly boil down a situation to the root issue and identify a solution that’s best for everyone. You are the final stop for customer account problems.

 - Technically Fluent: You can drive technical conversations with CTOs, engineers, and product folks. Being able to solution with our customers and our CS team is vital.

 - No Problem Too Big, No Problem Too Small: You understand what it means to join an early stage team that needs to take a function from 1 to 100. You lead by example and are always willing to roll up your sleeves alongside your teammates and customers.




THE ROLE

As the Head of Customer Success, you will lead Metriport’s customer facing function that owns the full customer life cycle post sales. This means everything from our implementation efforts during pilot period to our expansion and renewal efforts.

You will be the final stop for all customer needs. You will work directly with our team of Implementation Engineers, Technical Account Managers, and Support Engineers to support customers, expand product adoption, and grow usage. You and the Customer Success team are the voice of the customer that is responsible for collaborating with other departments (Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing).

This role is a player/coach role. In the early days, you will fully own accounts and get up to speed on Metriport’s current processes - this will enable you to make the swiftest impact in the Head of Customer Success role. We expect the Head of Customer Success to quickly bring their knowledge and skills to bear on the team and existing processes. As the team grows, we expect to see the vast majority of this hire’s time spent on unblocking customers and teammates, streamlining processes, and improving key metrics.




YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

 - Account Health: Creating an account health measurement and resulting actions/policies to ensure success of all customers.

 - Global Customer Success Metrics: GRR, NRR, logo retention, NPS, and more!

 - Final Resolutions: Ensuring Customer Success can resolve customer needs swiftly and appropriately. The buck stops with you!

 - Customer Insights: Creating a system for Customer Success to successfully be voice of the customer - sharing vital insights across the organization.

 - Leading the Team: Implementing processes and systems, upskilling team members, and eventually leading CS hiring efforts.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience: 7+ years of experience with at least 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions or Implementations

 - Role Relevancy: Previous Head of CS, Head of Account Management, Head of Implementations, etc.

 - Account Specific Experience: Experience managing both large enterprise accounts and larger volumes of mid-tier and startup accounts.

 - Company Specific Experience: Experience working at an early stage startup and seeing Customer Success grow from 1 to 100. Specifically, you’ve been at an early stage startup between Seed and Series C.

 - Autonomy: Comfortable taking an ambiguous objective, breaking it down to ensure alignment, identifying the most efficient way to accomplish it, and executing.

 - Eng Experience: You were an engineer in a past life and still use your skills within non-engineering roles.

 - Location: Based in San Francisco (or willing to relocate) to work from our South Beach office.

 - The "Metriport" Mindset: Low ego, high ownership. You are someone who asks "Why can't this be done in 3 days?" instead of 3 weeks.



Bonus Points:

 - Healthcare Domain: Experience within the healthcare space; specific experience in healthcare interoperability is a significant bonus.




BENEFITS

 - Equity: Competitive equity + compensation package 🚀

 - Healthcare: Full family Platinum health insurance, dental, and vision coverage 🦷

 - Retirement: 401(k) retirement plan + matching 💰

 - Flexibility: Flexible work from home or in-office 🏢

 - Food: Healthy lunches complimentary when in-office (and breakfast + dinners as needed) 🍏

 - Gear: MacBook provided by us 💻

 - PTO: Unlimited PTO (we work hard, but trust you to take the time you need to be at your best) 🧘‍♂️
   
   

Metriport provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

jobs.title: Senior Data & AI Engineer
jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

The Senior Data and AI Engineer will serve as a senior hands-on technical owner for solutions that transform structured and unstructured data from real-world electronic medical records (EMRs) into reliable, standardized clinical data. The role will design and deliver data engineering and clinical natural language processing (NLP) pipelines to integrate, identify, and normalize diseases, diagnoses, laboratory tests and results, demographics, signs and symptoms, medications, procedures, and other information supporting clinical, scientific, and business operations.

This role combines data engineering, clinical NLP, medical terminology and ontology expertise, applied AI, OMOP data modeling, and production software engineering. The engineer will harmonize structured EMR data, interpret clinical narratives, and integrate these sources into a transplant-focused OMOP Common Data Model (CDM). Success requires sound technical judgment, strong clinical domain knowledge, close collaboration with clinicians, and ownership from data integration and validation through deployment and ongoing production support.

Responsibilities:

• Own the design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance of pipelines that integrate structured EMR data and process unstructured clinical narratives.

• Develop entity and relationship extraction workflows for diagnoses, symptoms, laboratory results, demographics, medications, allergies, and procedures, linking findings to relevant values, units, doses, routes, frequencies, anatomical sites, and dates.

• Normalize structured source codes and extracted clinical concepts using ICD, SNOMED CT, RxNorm, LOINC, and other appropriate terminologies; manage local codes, synonyms, abbreviations, ambiguous mappings, terminology versions, and hospital-specific language.

• Implement clinical context interpretation, including negation, uncertainty, temporality, experiencer, and treatment status. Distinguish current conditions from historical, family, hypothetical, and ruled-out findings.

• Handle clinical note structure, copied-forward content, conflicting statements, and information spanning sentences or encounters. Reconcile extracted findings with structured EMR records using defined source and time precedence rules while retaining discrepancies, source evidence, and clinical timelines.

• Build and evaluate hybrid approaches using rules, dictionaries, statistical or deep learning models, and LLMs; apply structured output validation and terminology checks to prevent unsupported facts and invalid codes.

• Partner with clinicians to define clinical data schemas, source mappings, annotation guidelines, reference datasets, and acceptance criteria; resolve annotation disagreements and translate clinical requirements into engineering specifications.

• Measure entity, relationship, assertion, and normalization performance; conduct clinical error analysis and validate generalization across hospitals, specialties, and note types using patient-level data separation and checks for data leakage.

• Preserve source text, note and encounter identifiers, extraction provenance, model and terminology versions, and review status. Establish confidence thresholds and human review workflows for ambiguous or high-impact outputs.

• Build ETL workflows, APIs, and validation controls to harmonize structured EMR fields and NLP outputs, including patient and encounter linkage, units, timestamps, and duplicate records; monitor data quality, throughput, reliability, and model performance, and resolve production issues.

• Document architecture and operational procedures, lead code and design reviews, mentor engineers, and communicate technical tradeoffs to clinical, scientific, product, and engineering stakeholders.

• Follow security, privacy, and compliance requirements for sensitive healthcare data, including HIPAA-aligned practices, least-privilege access, appropriate logging, and secure data handling.

• Design and maintain mappings and transformation pipelines for a transplant-focused OMOP CDM, representing transplant procedures, donor and recipient information, immunosuppressive therapies, laboratory results, rejection episodes, and longitudinal outcomes using appropriate standard concepts and documented extensions where needed.

Qualifications

• Education: Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, Biomedical Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience: 7+ years of relevant experience in NLP, machine learning, or applied AI engineering, including 3+ years developing clinical NLP solutions using real-world EHR or hospital notes, with demonstrated delivery of production solutions.

• Advanced Python and SQL skills, with experience using pandas or comparable data-processing tools, relational data modeling, ETL orchestration, incremental processing, schema validation, and automated data-quality checks.

• Hands-on experience integrating structured EMR data through HL7 FHIR, HL7 v2, APIs, or database extracts; ability to align patient and encounter records, normalize units and timestamps, manage duplicates, and reconcile conflicting clinical sources.

• Hands-on experience with the OMOP Common Data Model and OHDSI standardized vocabularies, including source-to-standard concept mapping, vocabulary relationships, and ETL development to transform structured EMR data and clinical NLP outputs into appropriate OMOP tables.

• Experience validating OMOP data for conformance, completeness, and plausibility, with traceable source mappings and quality controls for longitudinal clinical records.

• Hands-on experience with clinical entity recognition and linking, relationship extraction, assertion detection, and temporal extraction, including clinical sentence and section detection, abbreviation disambiguation, negation, uncertainty, and experiencer identification.

• Experience implementing clinical NLP pipelines using medspaCy, scispaCy, cTAKES, or comparable frameworks, combining rules, dictionaries, and machine learning based on task requirements and measured performance.

• Practical expertise with ICD, SNOMED CT, RxNorm, LOINC, and UMLS, including terminology services, value sets, semantic types, ontology hierarchies, concept retrieval and disambiguation, local-code crosswalks, and terminology version management; experience with unit normalization using UCUM or equivalent methods.

• Experience applying and evaluating transformer models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent frameworks and Hugging Face Transformers or comparable tooling; hands-on experience with LLM-based clinical extraction, schema-constrained outputs, and terminology-grounded validation.

• Strong understanding of medical terminology, common diseases, laboratory measurements, medications, and clinical workflows. Ability to apply clinical reasoning to interpret documentation, distinguish evidence from inference, select appropriate concept specificity, and recognize ambiguous findings requiring clinician review.

• Experience creating clinician-reviewed reference datasets and annotation guidelines; measuring precision, recall, and F1 for extraction, normalization, and assertion tasks; preventing patient-level data leakage; and evaluating performance across source systems and note types.

• Experience building production APIs or services, deploying containerized applications on a cloud platform, and using Git, automated testing, CI/CD, model and data versioning, monitoring, batch inference, error recovery, and performance testing.

• Demonstrated ability to lead technical work independently, mentor engineers, document designs and operational procedures, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to clinicians, clinical informaticists, scientists, data engineers, and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with transplant clinical data or research, including donor and recipient characteristics, immunosuppressive therapies, graft function, rejection, and longitudinal outcomes.

• Experience with OHDSI tools such as Usagi, Achilles, or Data Quality Dashboard, and designing documented OMOP extensions when standard concepts or structures do not adequately represent domain requirements.

• Experience adapting or fine-tuning biomedical or clinical language models, active learning, distributed processing, and optimizing inference for high-volume clinical data.

• Experience with OCR and document layout processing for scanned clinical records, including assessment of how OCR errors affect extraction quality.

Additional Details:

Every individual at CareDx has a direct impact on our collective mission to improve the lives of organ transplant patients worldwide. We believe in taking great care of our people, so they take even greater care of our patients.

Our competitive Total Rewards package for US Employees includes:

• Competitive base salary and incentive compensation

• Health and welfare benefits, including a gym reimbursement program

• 401(k) savings plan match

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Pre-tax commuter benefits

• And more!

• Please refer to our page to view detailed benefits at https://caredx.com/company/careers

In addition, we have a Living Donor Employee Recovery Policy that allows up to 30 days of paid leave annually to a full-time employee who makes the selfless act of donating an organ or bone marrow.

With products that are making a difference in the lives of transplant patients today and a promising pipeline for the future, it’s an exciting time to be part of the CareDx team. Join us in partnering with transplant patients to transform our future together.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description:
ABOUT 3Y HEALTH

3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into other specialties.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation

 - Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile

 - Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version

 - Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code

 - Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response

 - Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship

 - Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes

 - Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex




OUR STACK

 - Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go

 - Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native

 - Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake

 - Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf

 - Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly

 - AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years of experience building and shipping production software

 - A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on

 - Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure

 - Comfort working in a large, established codebase

 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)

 - Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit.

 - Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library

 - High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to

 - Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR)

 - Temporal or another durable workflow engine

 - React Native

 - Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production

 - Building your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent

 - Open-source work, side projects or internal tools that other people use



If you meet most of the requirements and the role interests you, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.

jobs.description:
The General Manager functions as the primary strategic business leader of the property with responsibility for all aspects of the operation, including guest and employee satisfaction, human resources, financial performance, sales and revenue generation and delivering a return on investment to both Aspen Hospitality and property ownership. Essential Job Functions

• Executes business plans designed to maximize property customer satisfaction, profitability, and market share

jobs.title: Part-Time Office Coordinator
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

Part-Time Office Coordinator

ATLANTA, GA  |  PINDROP HEADQUARTERS  |  ON-SITE

Looking for a flexible, part-time role where you can make a real impact and get a front-row seat to life inside a growing AI company? Ever seen The Intern? Think that… but at an AI company.

This might be the perfect role for you!

At Pindrop, we’re looking for someone to help keep our Atlanta headquarters running smoothly and make the office a place people genuinely enjoy coming to.

You’ll meet some pretty incredible people and experience all the joys of office life. Yes, that includes meetings, calendars, conference rooms, and the occasional mystery package.

But note: we’re looking for someone who takes the little things seriously.

Someone who is exceptionally responsible, ridiculously detail-oriented, and has a genuine service mindset. The kind of person who notices the coffee is running low before it’s gone, remembers that someone has a dietary restriction, and takes pride in making everyone else’s day a little easier.

Corporate experience isn’t required. You do need great judgment, a positive attitude, and the ability to own your responsibilities without someone constantly reminding you.

What You’ll Be Doing

Be the person who keeps everything running.

• Manage incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and deliveries.

• Keep our office stocked with snacks, drinks, coffee, and supplies. (Yes, people take their snacks seriously.)

• Track inventory, manage orders, and stay within budget.

• Keep our meeting rooms organized, stocked, and ready for action.

Own Wednesday Lunch.

Wednesday is our main in-office day, and we provide lunch for the team. You’ll be the mastermind behind making it happen.

• Coordinate weekly lunch orders, vendors, headcounts, and dietary needs.

• Make sure food arrives on time and everything is set up beautifully.

• Handle cleanup and all the little details that make the experience great.

• Occasionally become everyone’s favorite person in the office.

Help us create a great office experience.

• Coordinate with building management, cleaning services, and other vendors.

• Help organize catering and logistics for meetings and special events.

• Manage parking access for employees and visitors.

• Keep our shared spaces welcoming, organized, and functioning.

• Spot things that need attention and take initiative to get them resolved.

Who We’re Looking For

Let’s talk about what really matters to us.

• You’re exceptionally dependable. If you say you’re going to do something, it gets done. No chasing, no reminding, no wondering.

• Details are your thing. You notice what others miss, and you genuinely enjoy making sure everything is just right.

• You have a service heart. You like helping people. Not because it’s in your job description, but because making someone’s day better makes yours better too.

• You’re proactive. You don’t wait to be told the coffee is empty, the conference room is messy, or the lunch order needs to be placed.

• You’re organized and resourceful. You can juggle multiple responsibilities, manage a budget, solve small problems independently, and know when to ask for help.

• You bring a positive attitude. You’re friendly, approachable, professional, and comfortable interacting with everyone from new employees to senior executives.

Prior experience in hospitality, customer service, administration, or office coordination is a plus, but attitude, accountability, and attention to detail matter more to us than your résumé.

The Details

• Location: Pindrop Headquarters, Atlanta, GA

• Schedule: Part-time, approximately 12+ hours per week

• Wednesdays are required: This is our primary in-office day, and we need you there to make the magic happen.

• Flexibility: Other scheduled days may vary based on office needs.

• On-site: This is a hands-on, in-person role.

• Essential functions: Moving around the office, standing for portions of the day, and lifting and carrying packages up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Why This Could Be a Great Opportunity

Whether you’re exploring a new field, returning to the workforce, supplementing other work, or simply want a flexible role, you’ll get exposure to how a growing AI company operates, build relationships across the organization, and develop skills that travel with you wherever your career takes you.

One Last Thing…

We’re a technology company, but this is very much a people role.

We’re looking for someone who understands that great employee experiences are often built on the smallest details.

If you’re the person who naturally takes charge of organizing the group dinner, notices when something is out of place, follows through on every commitment, and genuinely enjoys taking care of others…

We’d love to meet you.

Come see what it’s like to be part of a growing AI company. We promise it’s not all spreadsheets and meetings. 😉

Pindrop is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all ages, backgrounds, and experience levels.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

US Base Pay Range

$30—$30 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

As a CSM at Pindrop, you are a trusted point of contact for your customers. managing renewal timelines

• Experience with Gainsight or a similar customer success platform, Salesforce, and Google Workspace

• Understanding of call center, CCaaS, or contact center infrastructure is preferred

• Experience in fraud, authentication, security, or adjacent technology environments is a plus

• Willing to travel up to 25% is required

What you'll do

• Manage a defined portfolio of commercial and mid-market accounts, proactively reviewing account history and aligning outreach to customer goals and lifecycle stage.

• Build rapport with day-to-day customer contacts and work toward becoming a trusted advisor for product and value conversations. Serve as the primary point of contact for your customers for the life of the relationship.

• Build and maintain success plans tied to customer-stated goals, with input from the account team. Lead adoption check-ins and identify where customers are underutilizing key product features.

• Communicate value delivered in terms customers can connect to their business outcomes. Quantify value realized vs. expected and align on results with customers.

• Manage day-to-day customer concerns and lower-complexity escalations with growing independence. Develop action plans for at-risk accounts and coordinate with Support or Product to resolve root causes.

• Partner with Account Executives, Support, and Product on customer initiatives. Translate customer feedback into clear summaries for internal teams and participate in cross-functional account discussions.

• Maintain and update account plans using provided templates, tracking progress against customer goals using Gainsight health scores.

• Assist customers with operationalizing new product features and quantify customer benefits. Educate customers on fraud and authentication best practices.

• Serve as conduit between customer and product team: communicate new features, support the enhancement request process, facilitate beta engagements, coordinate case studies and customer references, and compile product feedback.

• Determine the optimal cadence of customer engagement to resolve open items, discuss performance, and drive product and feature adoption.

• Execute annual satisfaction surveys and report results internally and to customers. Manage contractual commitments and track subscription license usage on a monthly basis.

• Leverage Gainsight, analytics, and reporting tools to manage customer health and engagement. Apply good judgment to system-generated signals rather than accepting them at face value.

What success looks like

• Customers know you and trust you as their go-to person at Pindrop.

• Adoption is on track, renewal risks are flagged early, and your accounts are well-documented in Gainsight.

• You are building multi-stakeholder relationships without needing manager backup.

• Your portfolio shows consistent health, engagement, and progress against customer goals.

• Internal teams receive clear, useful customer feedback from you on a regular basis.

• You manage a defined portfolio with growing independence, not yet the most complex or highest-ARR accounts.

• You are building the relationship depth, renewal ownership, and cross-functional habits that prepare you for Senior CSM.

• You execute against established playbooks while developing the judgment to know when to escalate and when to own it.

• You understand the value of strong relationships and cultivate them both internally and externally

• You are resilient in the face of challenges, change, and ambiguity

• You are optimistic and believe that you can make a problem into a solution

• You have a passion for improving the customer experience in the voice channel

• You have the ability to analyze data to find and understand trends and ultimately offer suggestions for improved performance

• You are resourceful, excited to uncover innovative solutions and teach yourself something new when needed

• You take accountability, do the things you say you'll do, under-promise and over-deliver

• You are nimble and adaptable when priorities change and continue to see the "forest through the trees"

• Experience managing a portfolio of commercial or mid-market accounts and building trusted relationships with customer contacts

• Ability to build and maintain success plans tied to customer goals and communicate value in business terms

jobs.title: Graduate Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
A LITTLE ABOUT US

incident.io http://incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.




YOUR WAY INTO TECH SALES

If you've been looking for an opportunity to break in, this is it.

We're looking for purposeful, high-potential people who take coaching well, brush off rejection, and are always finding ways to level up. You don't need sales experience. As long as you have the raw ingredients, we can teach the rest.

Sales Academy is a 3-month program where you'll learn from proven sales leaders and all-star sellers, and you'll be selling a product customers love. The world's best engineering teams rely on incident.io http://incident.io when things go wrong, so you'll start your career with something worth talking about.

 


WHAT THAT LOOKS LIKE DAY TO DAY

You'll start in January 2027 alongside a cohort of people who, like you, have never done this job before. You get to be bad at it in front of people who are also bad at it, and get good fast.

Part one: training. You'll get intensive training and support from our sales leaders and tenured sellers. It covers researching prospects, cold calling, writing outreach people want to answer, and handling objections. You'll also learn how incident.io http://incident.io works, who we sell to, and why they buy. There's daily practice, homework, and plenty of coaching from people who want to see you succeed.

Part two: doing the job. For the rest of the academy, you'll work as a Business Development Rep (BDR) on live accounts. You'll make calls and send outreach, and the meetings you book will feed our pipeline. By the end, you'll be able to hold your own on a cold call with a CTO.

 


WHAT YOU GET OUT OF IT

It all starts here. BDRs are the bench for the rest of our go-to-market team. People in this seat go on to become Account Executives, Account Managers, and Customer Success Managers. The goal is for everyone who finishes the academy to convert to a permanent BDR, launching a long, high-trajectory career here at incident.io http://incident.io.

Alongside sales training, you'll get professional development and networking opportunities across the wider business. We want you to feel like part of our culture from day one, not someone passing through.

If you don't convert, you'll still have had three months of paid, on-the-job training. You'll leave with tested, marketable hard skills and a clearer sense of your strengths and where you'd do your best work. We'll do our best to help you with your next move.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - You've never been a BDR before. You might be a new grad, someone switching careers (teaching, the military, sport, performing), or someone from traditional sales like retail, door-to-door, events, or fundraising. We care about what you're capable of, not what's on your resume.

 - You really want this. You're not drifting into tech sales. You've decided, and you can tell us why.

 - You're seriously curious. About people, about what's keeping a VP of Engineering up at night, and about why one call landed when another didn't.

 - You've had to be resilient already. You've held a room, or heard "no" over and over without taking it personally.

 - You like being coached. Someone has told you the honest version of how you're doing, and you got better for it.

 - The phone doesn't scare you. You may never have made a cold call, but talking to strangers all day sounds fun rather than horrifying.

 - You want the cohort. Learning alongside other people, being measured against them, and wanting them to do well too sounds good to you, not stressful.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS AT A GLANCE

 - Stage 1: Application & aptitude assessment. Send us your LinkedIn profile and your contact details. From there, we'll email a link to complete a 25-minute aptitude assessment.

 - Stage 2: On-site interview. A half day in our San Francisco office with the sales team.

 - Stage 3: Offer.

 


GOOD TO KNOW

 - This role is based in our San Francisco office. You're welcome to apply from outside the Bay Area, but you'll need to be in the office from day one, working five days per week in office. 

 - We don't provide relocation assistance for this role.

 - This is a 3-month temporary role, and the goal is to convert you to a permanent employee when the academy ends.

 - Benefits start when you convert to a permanent role. You won't be eligible for our employee benefit plans during the 3-month academy.

 - Our first cohort starts in January 2027. Applications for this cohort close on December 1st. We'll begin hiring for our April 2027 cohort January 4th.

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.



Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. Partners are one of Abacum's fastest-growing areas of growth and we're investing to make them even more strategic. 

As a Senior Partner Account Manager, you'll own a portfolio of our most strategic technology and advisory partners in North America. That includes the ERPs, accounting platforms, and finance-stack companies whose customers are Abacum's best-fit buyers as well as key advisory firms who help customers transform their finance operations. You'll turn our partner relationships into repeatable, measurable pipeline and successful joint customers. 

This is a senior individual contributor role on the Partnerships team, working closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and our Partner Solutions team.

Benefits

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

jobs.title: Principal Mechanical Engineer (Starship)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PRINCIPAL MECHANICAL ENGINEER (STARSHIP)

SpaceX is looking for a Principal Mechanical Engineer to help build the infrastructure behind power generation and supercompute at Starbase. You will own mechanical scope from concept through design, fabrication, construction, and commissioning. The work can span power generation, fluid and cooling systems, and the structures and equipment that production depends on. You will set the technical direction, work across engineering, construction, and operations, and see your decisions show up in hardware that has to perform in the field.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop design concepts from a clean sheet and size infrastructure systems based on operational loads, site conditions, and how the facility will actually run

• Collaborate with peers across disciplines to develop designs that balance cost, schedule, reliability, and capability

• Create detailed designs and generate CAD models for components, assemblies, and integration into the larger site

• Build analysis models to assess your designs in detail and confirm they meet the needs of the system

• Apply first-order hand calculations and empirical formulas to assess and iterate on your designs rapidly

• Validate your designs through development hardware, mockups, or first articles, and test critical joints, components, and design elements

• Support testing and commissioning of subsystems and full installations

• Partner with construction, build engineers, and technicians to improve your designs

• Support installation of your hardware in the field, witness your designs being built and brought online, and see them go into service

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline

• 7+ years of experience with mechanical design and analysis

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience designing, analyzing, building, and testing high performance, mechanical systems

• Experience working within interdisciplinary teams to develop solutions to challenging and complex problems

• Experience with FEA or multiphysics simulation package (e.g. NASTRAN, ABAQUS, ANSYS)

• Experience designing and executing qualification testing

• Strong understanding of mechanical first principles and structural analysis methodologies

• Proficiency in selecting materials and manufacturing methods for mechanical components

• Analytical/scientific programming experience (i.e. Python, Matlab, Excel)

• Self-motivated with strong organizational, written, and oral communication skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be available to work extended hours and weekends when needed based on site operational needs; flexibility required

jobs.title: Manufacturing Technician II/III - Buffer Prep (2nd Shift, M-F, 3pm-11:30pm)
jobs.description:
The field of gene therapy is growing rapidly and Genezen is here to meet the exacting needs of our clients. We provide process development, produce GMP viral vectors, and provide cell transduction for gene and cell therapy clinical trials and are proud to be a part of the process that leads to new cures.

WORKING AT GENEZEN

Many people have worked in environments where you feel like just another nameless part of an enormous machine. Genezen is different. We want our employees to be innovative, collaborative problem solvers who are dedicated to meeting the challenges of working at a fast-growing company. We are dedicated to empowering our employees to be their best and making Genezen a rewarding place to work. Every employee contributes to the success of the company and you can be part of that team.

JOB SUMMARY

Genezen is seeking a Manufacturing Technician II/III to play a hands-on-role in the production of clinical and/or commercial cell and gene therapy products, helping our partners deliver life-changing advanced therapies to patients. This role is responsible for performing routine and non-routine manufacturing operations in a cGMP environment, including process execution, in-process controls, equipment operation, and documentation, while working closely with MSAT, QC, QA, Engineering, and Validation teams to ensure safe, compliant, and high-quality manufacturing operations.

The position is on the 2nd shift, Monday-Friday, 3pm-11:30pm in our Lexington, MA facility.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Manufacturing Operations

• Execute routine and non-routine production activities according to the manufacturing schedule.

• Follow cGMP requirements, SOPs, batch records, and solution preparation records.

• Use the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system to execute transactions accurately and in real-time.

• Demonstrate and apply aseptic processing techniques.

• Operate in production areas such as, but not limited to, Pre-culture, USP, DSP, buffer preparation, and Fill Finish.

• Perform troubleshooting activities within established procedures.

• Participate in shift handoffs and communicate critical production information.

• Support off-shift, overtime, and holiday production activities as required.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify and communicate opportunities for process, procedural, and operational improvements.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and problem-solving activities.

Documentation & Compliance

• Complete manufacturing documentation accurately and in real time following GDP principles.

• Review batch records, solution records, logbooks, and forms for completeness and accuracy.
