jobs.title: People Operations Generalist
jobs.description:
About Abacum



Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.



Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.



We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.



Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a People Operations Generalist to join our People team and support our growing North American organization.

This is a hands-on People Operations role with ownership across the US and Canada, with a strong focus on payroll, employee lifecycle management, compliance, benefits, office management, and operational execution.

You will manage key People processes from the moment an employee joins through onboarding, payroll, employee changes, leaves and off-boarding, ensuring every process is accurate, compliant and well documented.

A key part of this role is managing payroll operations across both the US and Canada, so we are looking for someone who already understands the operational requirements of working across both countries and can confidently partner with payroll providers, Finance and external advisors.

You will work closely with the Global People Manager, Finance, external payroll providers and managers across the company.

Note that this is a hybrid role in our beautiful Midtown office Tuesday-Thursday.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Employee lifecycle

Own People Operations across the full employee lifecycle for employees in the US and Canada, including onboarding, employee changes, leaves, documentation and off-boarding.

Ensure employee records and documentation remain accurate and consistent across systems.



US & Canada payroll

Own the operational preparation and review of payroll across both the United States and Canada.

Manage payroll inputs including new hires, terminations, salary changes, variable compensation, benefits and other employee changes.

Partner with payroll providers and Finance to ensure every payroll cycle is accurate, compliant and completed on time.

Identify and resolve payroll discrepancies and continuously improve payroll processes.



People Operations & compliance

Act as an operational point of reference for employees and managers across the US and Canada on payroll, benefits, PTO, leaves, employee documentation and People processes.

Maintain awareness of relevant employment requirements across both countries and coordinate with external advisors when specialist guidance is needed.

Translate regulatory requirements into practical and scalable internal processes.

You will be the go-to representative for the People team in the NYC office and will need to provide on the ground support for the CEO and Chief of Staff.



Onboarding & off-boarding

Coordinate onboarding requirements, employment documentation and operational setup for new hires.

Manage voluntary and involuntary employee exits, including payroll, benefits, documentation and system updates.

Ensure every transition is handled accurately, consistently and with the appropriate level of care and compliance.



HR systems, data & documentation

Maintain accurate employee data across our HR systems and internal tools.

Own recurring People Operations workflows and documentation.

Build and maintain clear SOPs and scalable processes.

Identify opportunities to simplify or automate manual processes.



Benefits & employee support

Support the administration of employee benefits across the US and Canada.

Act as a trusted point of contact for employees on People Operations questions.

Provide clear and practical guidance while maintaining confidentiality, consistency and professional judgement.




ABOUT YOU

You are a hands-on People Operations professional who enjoys making complex operational processes work smoothly.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable working across different employment frameworks, providers and jurisdictions.

You understand the operational differences between the US and Canada and are confident managing payroll and employee lifecycle processes across both countries.

You are comfortable taking ownership independently while working closely with the broader People team.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on payroll experience in both the US and Canada is essential.

 - 5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR Operations or a similar generalist role.

 - Strong experience managing employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, compensation changes, leaves and offboarding.

 - Practical knowledge of US and Canadian People Operations, including payroll, benefits, employment documentation and leave administration.

 - Experience working with external payroll providers, PEOs, or similar partners.

 - Strong HR systems, data and process mindset.

 - Strong judgement and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive employee matters.

 - Comfortable taking ownership and improving processes in a fast-growing international environment.




WHY THIS ROLE

You will join a lean People team at a stage where our North American presence is growing quickly.

You will have real ownership over the operational foundations behind how we onboard, pay, support and off-board employees across the US and Canada, while helping us build processes that can scale with the company.



Benefits

 - Competitive compensation including equity package

 - Competitive vacation policy

 - Medical Insurance

 - L&D budget

 - Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

 - Language courses (English / Spanish)



Our Values


Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.



Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.



Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.



Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.



Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Locum Band 4 Speech and Language Therapy Assistant – Preston, Lancashire

Banding: Band 4
Location: Ribbleton Clinic, Langden Drive, Ribbleton, Preston, PR2 6HT
Start Date: ASAP
Salary: £15.00–£17.00 per hour
Working Hours: Part-time or full-time
Duration: 3 months

Job Overview

We are currently seeking a dedicated and compassionate Band 4 Speech and Language Therapy Assistant to join the Neuro Rehabilitation Team based at Ribbleton Clinic in Preston. This is an exciting opportunity to support qualified therapists in delivering specialised communication and swallowing rehabilitation to patients within their own homes and community clinic settings.

The successful candidate will work closely with registered therapists and other healthcare professionals to support patients throughout their rehabilitation journey. You will play an important role in helping patients improve their communication and swallowing abilities by carrying out delegated therapy activities, monitoring progress, and providing feedback to the supervising therapist.

This locum opportunity is ideal for someone with relevant experience in speech and language therapy support who is confident working independently in community settings and is passionate about delivering high-quality, patient-centred care.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• Support qualified Speech and Language Therapists in delivering specialised communication and swallowing rehabilitation to patients in their homes and community clinics.

• Carry out delegated communication and swallowing (dysphagia) exercises in accordance with therapy plans developed by registered therapists.

• Travel independently to visit patients in community settings while maintaining regular communication with supervising clinicians.

• Work collaboratively with physiotherapists, occupational therapists, nurses, and other members of the multidisciplinary team to support effective community rehabilitation.

• Accurately record patient progress, maintain up-to-date clinical notes, and report any changes in patients' conditions to the supervising therapist.

• Follow clinical guidance, care plans, and relevant health and safety procedures to ensure safe and effective patient care.

Qualifications and Experience

To be considered for this role, you should have:

• Relevant experience supporting Speech and Language Therapists or working in a healthcare or rehabilitation setting.

• An understanding of communication and swallowing difficulties, including dysphagia.

• The ability to follow delegated therapy programmes and work within the scope of your role.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organisational skills.

• The confidence to work independently when visiting patients in their homes and community settings.

• The ability to maintain accurate clinical records and communicate patient progress effectively.

• A flexible, proactive, and compassionate approach to patient care.

• The ability to work collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Why Choose Pulse?

From the moment you register with Pulse, our focus is entirely on you. With exclusive access to roles across the UK, we offer a personalised and supportive recruitment experience that puts your career first.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Asset Living is a third-party management firm with a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

Regional Maintenance Supervisor

This key role will be responsible for overseeing the regional maintenance management functions across multiple locations within a designated region. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in maintenance management, a strategic mindset, and the ability to lead and inspire a team to ensure optimal operational performance and excellence in service delivery.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Conduct site visits on a regular basis including but not limited to review of curb appeal, maintenance projects, reports, work productivity, site inventories, adherence to policies and procedures, capital improvement project review and completion of quarterly community standards inspections.

• Work with on-site team and Regional Manager to correct any deficiencies identified in site inspections promptly.

• Reinforce community environmental safety programs such as Asbestos, LBP and Mold response policies to ensure all facilities comply with local, state, and federal regulations and safety standards.

• Identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements while maintaining high-quality standards.

• Develop and implement emergency response plans to address potential crises and ensure business continuity.

• Conduct drills and training sessions to prepare facility staff for various emergency scenarios.

• Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as makeready and workorder completion times to assess the performance and effectiveness of maintenance teams and collaborate with the on-site manager and maintenance manager when performance improvement is needed.

• Analyze KPI data to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities for enhancing operational efficiency.

• Assist with implementing and ensuring compliance with programs at the site level such as Predictive and Preventative Maintenance, Emergency Preparedness, Preferred Vendor Programs, etc. at each site as outlined by Asset Living’s policy.

• Assist Regional Manager and Director of Facilities in the development of capital budgets annually.

• Assist with developing scopes, assist with bid analysis, and monitor project management for capital projects to ensure effective utilization of the annual budget, selection of vendors and the services provided, and the timely completion of services covered by the contract.

• Assist Client Services with due diligence and transitions by participating in site inspections, preparing reports, and evaluating staff as requested.

• Support other operational goals and objectives as defined and needed by the Director of Facilities and VP of Operations.

• Any other tasks assigned or directed.

Team Leadership

• Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork and professional development.

• Demonstrate consistent and appropriate sense of urgency and foster urgency among maintenance team and contract personnel.

• Partner with the Training team to develop bench strength through building and delivering education to the maintenance teams across the organization.

• Foster interdepartmental communication protocol and assist personnel in effective communication between office and maintenance department.

Education & Experience

• Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, leadership technique, production methods, and coordination of people and resources.

• Understanding of current legal responsibilities of the properties.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact and relate effectively, productively, and positively with other Associates.

• Possess the ability to effectively lead and manage a team.

• Proficient in Microsoft Word, Office, and Outlook.

• Ability to have flexibility with working schedule based on business and deadline needs.

• Ability to work a schedule during normal work hours and that may be other than Monday-Friday, 8-5. Work more than 40 hours per week is likely.

• Consistent, regular, and in-person attendance during regular working hours at the workplace is required.

• EPA and CPO certifications required.

Travel Requirements

• This position entails travel, estimated at 50-60% of work time annually. Travel may be required for property visits, conferences, training sessions, or other business-related activities.

PointOne is the AI revenue platform for professional services.

We’re a Tier 1 venture-backed startup (Y Combinator, Bessemer, 8VC, General Catalyst) that has raised over $20M and grown revenue over 17x over the past 12 months.

- Strong communication skills,

- A desire to progress within sales, whether it be becoming an account executive, driving GTM strategy, and/or entering sales leadership,

jobs.title: Security & Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT POINTONE

PointOne builds infrastructure for the legal industry, powering timekeeping and billing systems used by law firms and government agencies.

We build and operate systems that process the most confidential data for institutions working on the most sensitive matters. Security for us is a strategic priority. 

We’re hiring a senior engineer to own the security, scalability, and cost efficiency of our AWS environment.




THE ROLE

Let’s start with what this isn’t:

 - Not a GRC or paperwork-heavy compliance role

 - Not a vulnerability-scanning-only position

 - Not a “turn on GuardDuty and call it done” role

You will be shaping critical systems and making architectural decisions that materially affect risk and resilience.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of security, cloud architecture, and platform optimization.

You will harden our AWS infrastructure, reduce blast radius, eliminate unnecessary exposure, and ensure our systems scale efficiently and securely.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Infrastructure Security

 - Design and enforce least-privilege IAM across services

 - Implement permission boundaries and SCP strategy

 - Reduce attack surface across networking and service exposure

 - Improve secrets management and KMS key segmentation

 - Lead threat modeling across core systems

 - Design blast-radius containment strategies

Detection & Response

 - Strengthen logging, monitoring, and anomaly detection

 - Ensure logs are immutable and auditable

 - Build and test incident response playbooks

 - Review new infrastructure designs for security risks

Scale & Cost

 - Optimize AWS architecture for reliability and efficiency

 - Improve Lambda/SQS concurrency and scaling patterns

 - Evaluate and improve RDS scaling strategy

 - Drive principled tradeoffs between isolation, performance, and cost




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years operating AWS infrastructure in production

 - Deep IAM expertise (roles, policies, trust relationships, STS)

 - Strong AWS networking knowledge (VPC, PrivateLink, Security Groups)

 - Experience designing multi-account AWS environments

 - Hands-on experience responding to real security incidents

 - Strong understanding of cloud attack vectors and privilege escalation

 - Experience reducing cloud cost without compromising security

 - Comfortable working directly in CDK/Terraform and reviewing infrastructure code

Strong plus: Experience in legal, fintech, government, or other high-sensitivity environments.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

A security breach at PointOne would have consequences extending far beyond the survival of our company. This role exists to:

 - Protect sensitive institutions

 - Raise the engineering bar on secure system design

 - Build infrastructure that enterprise and government customers can trust

You will be a core architect of PointOne’s long-term security posture.



This is intense early-stage startup work. You will be expected to take ownership, bring structure to ambiguity, and build the connective tissue between our customers and our product.



The compensation for this position is determined by multiple factors, including prior experience and expertise. A competitive equity component will also be offered as part of the package. Benefits include comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, as well as meals in office, regular team events, and more!

jobs.title: Head of AI Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Accela is seeking a Head of AI Strategy & Operations to help teams across the company use AI effectively and responsibly. You will shape our enterprise AI strategy, set practical standards, and guide investments that improve how people work and deliver measurable results.

As Accela becomes an AI-first company, you will help turn that ambition into everyday practices, useful tools, and stronger employee capabilities. You will work with business and technical leaders to set priorities, support experimentation, and give executives a clear view of progress, costs, and risks. Each function will continue to own its workflows and results.

This role combines strategic thinking, practical AI experience, and the ability to bring people together around shared goals. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, IT, Security, Legal, Privacy, GRC, HR, Finance, Procurement, and functional leaders to make responsible AI adoption easier and faster. Functions retain ownership of their workflows, delivery, and outcomes. You own the enterprise strategy, requirements, operating model, and portfolio visibility that help those teams execute consistently. You will partner closely to align enterprise requirements with operational needs and incorporate evidence from that portfolio into enterprise decisions.

Responsibilities:

• Shape AI strategy. Develop Accela’s enterprise AI strategy and investment priorities. Assess the company’s AI capabilities and readiness, and align plans with business goals, available resources, and acceptable risk.

• Prioritize opportunities. Work with business and technical leaders to identify promising uses of AI. Weigh expected benefits, readiness, data needs, effort, risk, and cost. Define success measures and recommend which initiatives to fund, expand, adjust, or stop.

• Lead AI governance. Establish clear risk categories, review processes, and approval criteria so teams can move forward responsibly and efficiently.

• Set practical requirements. Translate legal, regulatory, contractual, and policy obligations—including those related to government customers—into clear requirements for security, privacy, data use, human oversight, and AI evaluation.

• Clarify ownership and decisions. Define responsibilities and handoffs from early experiments through deployment and retirement. Resolve conflicts between enterprise and functional requirements within your authority, document decisions, and respect existing approval responsibilities.

• Maintain portfolio visibility. Keep a current company-wide view of AI initiatives, approved tools, owners, investments, dependencies, and risks.

• Support employee adoption. Provide training suited to different roles, practical guides, templates, office hours, and peer learning. Build an AI champion network and use employee feedback to make approved tools and practices easier to use.

• Build team capabilities. Partner with functional leaders to address skill gaps, support changing roles, and set AI goals that improve workflows, quality, employee experience, and business results.

• Guide technology choices. Work with Engineering, IT, Security, and other responsible teams to select approved tools, reduce duplication, and develop reusable capabilities. Evaluate when to build, buy, or configure solutions.

• Establish technical standards. Partner with implementation teams on access controls, activity records, monitoring, incident response, and ongoing management of AI systems.

• Test ideas in practice. Use AI-assisted development and targeted prototypes to test assumptions before larger investments. Work closely with teams that build and operate production systems to understand technical constraints and trade-offs.

• Measure results and costs. Build an executive scorecard covering adoption, business outcomes, quality, reliability, risk, cost, and value. Work with Finance and functional owners to establish baselines, verify benefits, and identify underused capabilities.

• Lead through collaboration. Build trusted relationships across business and technical teams. Partner closely with the Senior Director, AI Transformation & Operations to align enterprise requirements with operational needs. Lead executive reviews with clear recommendations, decisions, and follow-through.

Requirements:

• 6+ years of experience in AI, AI strategy, or technology strategy, including leadership of complex initiatives involving multiple teams.

• Experience establishing enterprise AI or technology governance, standards, operating practices, or adoption programs.

• Practical experience with large language models, retrieval, agents, workflow automation, AI evaluation, and AI-assisted development sufficient to prototype and assess solutions.

• Ability to prioritize opportunities, turn unclear business problems into actionable requirements, and deliver measurable operational or financial results.

• Strong communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to explain technical topics clearly, build agreement, and lead without direct authority.

• Relevant credentials, such as IAPP AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer, ISACA AAISM, CRISC, or CGEIT, or equivalent practical experience implementing enterprise AI governance.

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience in enterprise SaaS, GovTech, or another regulated environment. Experience working with security, risk, or compliance teams. Experience building AI champion networks, employee learning programs, or shared internal AI capabilities.

ABOUT ACCELA
For nearly 20 years, Accela has been an industry leader in designing and delivering government software to improve efficiency, increase citizen engagement and enable the development of thriving communities. Today, citizens are savvy to how services should be delivered, and expect a consistently convenient, openly transparent view into their local government. While government agencies struggle to do more with less, our mission has never been more critical. Accela provides a robust, cloud-based platform of government software solutions that accelerate growth, efficiency, and transparency in communities of all sizes. From planning, to building, to service request management and more, Accela’s SaaS offerings level the playing field for small and medium governments and enable smaller agencies to leverage larger city technologies. Our open and flexible technology helps agencies address specific needs today, while ensuring they are well prepared for the emerging challenges of the future.

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION
Accela believes in developing and nurturing a workplace community where our differences are celebrated, and everyone feels a sense of psychological safety and belonging. Accela is committed to putting resources and attention towards evolving our practices, policies, and philosophies to enable diversity to thrive and to support equity in opportunity for everyone.

COMPENSATION AND WELL-BEING
The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $240,000-$280,000 (less applicable taxes). The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience. In addition to an annual base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus target. This is a discretionary bonus awarded based on company and individual goal achievement.

Accela’s U.S. team members will receive a generous benefits package consisting of options including flexible time off, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, family planning benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, health savings account with company contributions, flexible spending account, life, accident, and disability coverage, business travel insurance, employee assistance programs, and other well-being benefits.

Accela is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Affirmative Action Employer and will respond to requests for job accommodations.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or based on disability, gender identity, and sexual orientation

jobs.title: Associate Program Manager
jobs.location: New York City, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Empower Sales teams with the operational tools, training, and documentation to win

The opportunity:

Flexport’s Enablement team runs the programs and documentation that keep the whole company informed globally, with a heavy focus on our sales team. We’re looking for someone to run those programs day to day — from the documentation Flexport relies on across the org to a brand-new onboarding experience for our Account Executives (AEs). You’ll own the AMER Leadership Development Rotational Program and support two of Enablement’s other biggest programs: AE onboarding and ongoing sales excellence, alongside knowledge management and documentation across Flexport. You’ll work closely with sales leadership, get regular exposure to Flexport’s C-suite, and grow your scope as the Enablement team grows.

You will:

• Own the AMER Leadership Development Rotational Program, an ~18-month rotation that places new grads across a rotation of 2-3 departments alongside a dedicated AI training curriculum.

• Support the AE onboarding program end-to-end: the six-week curriculum, the capstone graduation, and the tools that make ramping up stick.

• Support day-to-day sales enablement for our AE team and help build the ongoing sales excellence program behind it, partnering with sales leadership to turn skill gaps into playbooks and training.

• Support Confluence and Flexport’s documentation ecosystem: page structure, content standards, and a regular audit cadence, so information stays accurate and easy to find company-wide.

• Stand up special projects fast, from product launches to market events, and become a go-to resource across the org.

• Measure program impact and run feedback loops to continuously improve what you build.

You should have:

• 2-3 years of experience in program management, sales enablement, sales operations, marketing, or a related field, with a working knowledge of Flexport’s products and the logistics industry (or the ability to pick it up fast).

• Excellent writing and communication skills. You can turn messy inputs into clear, useful documentation and summarize quickly.

• Extremely organized, comfortable managing multiple projects at once, and able to move without a fully scoped brief.

• Comfortable presenting to and partnering with senior leadership, including the C-suite.

• Experience building training content or curriculum, and genuine enthusiasm for building decks, docs, and Confluence pages from scratch.

• Skilled at driving adoption and buy-in for new programs. You don’t just build the thing, you get people to use it.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners, specifically in cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We’re backed by top investors, including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity—in backgrounds and experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble, and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building, seeking teammates who are not only strong in their own aptitudes, but who also care deeply about supporting each other’s growth.

As an early-stage startup employee, you’ll have the opportunity to help build the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by consolidating up to 50% of their work and improving work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you’ll find a home at Fieldguide.



 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Staff Product Designer to join the Fieldguide team. You’ll own complex, ambiguous problem spaces end-to-end, partner deeply with Product and Engineering, and help shape the design direction of a core Fieldguide product.

We move incredibly fast at Fieldguide, and we’re looking for designers who can operate at that cadence. This team ships frequently, iterates in tight loops, and makes progress amid ambiguity. You should be comfortable balancing speed with craft, incorporating AI into your daily design practice, and designing AI-assisted workflows directly into the product. This is a high-impact role for someone excited to own unclear problems, drive momentum, and help modernize audit workflows that customers depend on every day.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Lead end-to-end design for complex, ambiguous audit workflows, from problem definition through shipped solutions

 - Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape strategy, influence roadmaps, and deliver high-quality, scalable implementations

 - Drive design execution with minimal direction, operating effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

 - Translate customer needs, research insights, and business goals into clear user journeys, interaction models, and polished UI

 - Balance speed and iteration with usability, consistency, and long-term product quality

 - Advocate for users while accounting for technical, regulatory, and business constraints

 - Own a significant product area or customer journey, anticipating downstream impacts across workflows and personas

 - Set a high bar for craft and influence by contributing to the design system, mentoring peers, and serving as a trusted design voice.
   
   


WHO YOU ARE:

 - 10+ year of experience in a Product Design role, ideally focused on complex, B2B SaaS products

 - You operate as a strategic IC — you don't just solve problems, you decide which problems matter

 - You think several steps ahead, anticipating how decisions in one area ripple across others

 - You're comfortable influencing senior PM and Engineering leaders, not just your immediate collaborators

 - Experience shaping how AI-assisted workflows get designed at a systemic level, not just within a single flow

 - You've coached or mentored other designers and can articulate why, not just what

 - You set a bar for craft and consistency that others look to as the standard

 - You can hold a long-term point of view while still shipping incrementally
   
   


BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience designing for audit, accounting, compliance, or other regulated domains

 - Track record of shaping design strategy across multiple teams, not just a single product area

 - Experience building or scaling design systems, standards, or team-wide processes

 - Background in workflow-heavy, document-centric, or B2B SaaS products

 - Experience coaching or managing designers, formally or informally

 - Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design practices at scale
   
   


MORE ABOUT FIELDGUIDE:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.


SOME OF OUR BENEFITS INCLUDE:

 - Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

 - Flexible PTO

 - 401k

 - Wellness benefits starting on your first day

 - Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

 - Flexible work schedules

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking a skilled and diligent full-time Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

• Support and enable internal business units through shared engineering services and functionalities, building the tools and processes for those teams to succeed.

• Build relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organization to understand and meet their needs with projects you'll own end to end.

• Work directly with internal customer facing teams to empower their mission and take pride in making their day-to-day lives easier. Work with product engineering to extract the data needed to drive business decisions.

• Example deliverables in this role might include:

• Improve observability through metrics, alerting, logging and telemetry integration

• Identify and build improvements for Continuous Deployment

• Utilize infrastructure as code to make changes in a cloud environment

• Collaborate with other engineering teams to build cross functional infrastructure improvements

• Automate upgrades for managed services and VMs.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully-remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfortably work asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

• Work as part of a team of engineers to design, build, test, and document core software components.

• Exhibit ownership over the running services that comprise Tailscale’s product by building for observability, participating in incident response, and fielding customer support escalations.

• Analyze and improve efficiency, scalability, and stability of various system resources.

What We Are Looking For

• Experience with CI/CD, secrets management, infrastructure as code, and observability

• Experience with distributed systems

• Experience with operating managed services in a cloud environment (preferably AWS)

• Experience with operating Kubernetes in production is a strong plus

• Familiarity with networks (IP addressing, routing, etc.)

• Most of the non-front-end portions of the system are developed in the Go programming language. Experience with Go is a plus.

• Ability to give and process constructive feedback, as well as work independently

• Flexibility to adjust to the dynamic nature of a startup

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

jobs.title: STRONG Pilates- Studio Leader - Tribeca
jobs.description:
Job Details

• Job Title: Studio Leader

• Type: Exempt

• Hours: 40+ hours per week, as business needs require

• Location: Tribeca NYC

• Compensation:$70-$80k + commission + bonus

Description

We are looking for a leader to join us to help lead STRONG Pilates locations around the US.

This isn't a job; this is an opportunity to make a difference! If you're looking for a job, you need not apply and we wish you the best.

About STRONG Pilates

STRONG Pilates is a high-intensity, low-impact, full-body workout that combines rowing and biking with Pilates-inspired movements, utilizing an innovative Rowformer and Bikeformer machine.

Unlike regular Pilates, the Rowformer and Bikeformer allow for an elevated heart rate by using the row and bike side, then transitioning back to the Pilates side. The increased intensity results in a substantial calorie burn, helping the consumer burn body fat while also receiving the benefits of Pilates.

With over 120 locations globally, STRONG Pilates blends Pilates, strength, and cardio into one membership and workout. STRONG Pilates is fast-growing in the US and globally.

What are we looking for:

We are seeking a highly motivated Sales & People leader to lead STRONG locations throughout the U.S. The Studio Leader will oversee all aspects of STRONG’s studio operations, people and culture, full profit and loss responsibility, and studio performance. This includes overseeing and driving revenue, sales, studio operations, customer experience, and community impact.

The ideal candidate is a leader in sales and customer-obsessed, with tremendous leadership skills. They have experience in selling themselves, coaching salespeople, sales team management, customer service training, marketing, lead generation, leadership, and always leading by example.

This is a high-impact, high-effort business role – your work will make a significant impact and contribution to the growth of STRONG, for which you will be rewarded.

Who is the right leader for this role:

You do not need to be a trainer or come from a fitness background for this role; we are looking for people who know how to lead and are passionate about business, people, and fitness!

You believe strongly in all things health and wellness and have a passion for living a healthy (mind and body) life. If you are results-driven, with an insatiable appetite for growth and a fast-paced/highly demanding work environment, this is the right opportunity for you. You love building and growing things, you like the challenge of revenue goals and surpassing them, and are interested in a career filled with growth opportunities.

Here are some of the things you'll do:

• Full profit and loss leadership of the 4 walls of your location

• Lead and inspire a team of wellness professionals to deliver outstanding client experiences.

• Organize the sales function of the studio around hundreds of members and thousands of leads regularly.

• Oversee daily studio operations, ensuring a clean, welcoming, and efficient environment.

• Manage scheduling, inventory, and financial transactions to optimize studio performance.

• Develop and implement strategies to drive membership sales and client retention.

• Foster a positive and inclusive studio culture that aligns with STRONG’s values.

• Coordinate and host marketing networking events, collaborations, and community outreach activities.

• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators, providing regular reports to upper management.

• Stay current with industry trends and continuously seek opportunities for innovation and improvement.

• Partner with StriveWell shared services to drive a successful location.

• Yes, sometimes you are the person who has to go when the fire alarm goes off, or if a colleague calls out, and yes, sometimes you might work late nights, early mornings, weekends, and weekdays.

Here is how we will measure your success:

You will be evaluated on the following metrics. Surpassing these metrics for a calendar year will open growth opportunities.

• Team member retention and satisfaction

• Studio Performance (revenue, expenses & EBITDA)

• Achieving & surpassing new member monthly goals

• Achieving revenue goals

• Successful secret shopper visit scores

• Listen 360 and team member culture scores

• Cultivating a culture of Unreasonable Hospitality

Here is what we want from you:

• Be growth-minded and curious with an interest in making those around you better.

• Proven experience in a leadership role within the health, wellness, or hospitality industry.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to motivate and manage a team.

• Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Passion for health, wellness, and a commitment to providing a top-notch client experience.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Proficiency in scheduling, inventory management, and financial reporting.

• Proficiency in Google Workspace and Excel.

• Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including evenings and weekends.

• 4+ years in sales

• 3+ year in leadership positions

• We encourage Studio Leaders to coach/lead/instruct up to 5 classes a week at a complimentary brand; may not work at a direct competitor

• We invite Studio Leaders to coach up to 4 classes per week at their location, generally with the impact class of the STRONG intro

• Bachelors is a plus, but not required

• Experience with membership sales is a significant advantage

Here is what we will offer you

• 2 weeks of Paid vacation

• $500 vacation stipend (we want you to recharge)

• STRONG Pilates swag

• Tremendous growth opportunity (join on the ground floor) -Succession planning and leader development are important to us

• Front seat view of entrepreneurship training and development

• Access to all STRONG and SWTHZ locations, for you and your partner/spouse

Where you will work:

This role will be located at our Tribeca, NYC location - candidates must be able and capable to travel to and from their location.

jobs.title: Organizational Change Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Organizational Change Manager plays a critical role in ensuring the successful implementation and sustainment of key process and technology changes across Centria Autism Services. This role is responsible for leading change initiatives, driving adoption among all roles within the organization, and ensuring long-term success through the development of change champions and leadership coaching.

Additionally, the Organizational Change Manager is responsible for ensuring that leadership teams are trained to the extent necessary to sustain the change. This includes ensuring that leadership understands not only the processes and tools associated with the change but also why the change is being implemented, enabling them to communicate, reinforce, and model the change effectively.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role that requires significant travel (75%) to various Centria locations to provide in-person support, training, and engagement.

Duties and Responsibilities

The below reflects the essential functions considered necessary for this role and shall not be construed as a detailed description of all work requirements inherent in the job or assigned by supervisory personnel. This job description is used as a guide only and not inclusive of all responsibilities and job duties.

• Change Implementation and Adoption

• Collaborate with the Implementation Specialist to develop strategic rollout plans that ensure smooth transitions for new systems and processes.

• Execute and routinize change initiatives in alignment with project charters, ensuring timely and effective implementation.

• Engage with team members at all levels to drive understanding, adoption, and execution of new processes and technologies.

• Provide on-site and virtual training, coaching, and support to ensure successful transitions.

• Develop and deploy communication strategies to promote awareness and buy-in for key initiatives.

2. Leadership Training and Competency Development

• Ensure that leadership teams are trained to the level required to sustain the change long-term.

• Ensure leadership competency in managing change, including understanding why the change is being implemented, the expected outcomes, and how to support staff through the transition.

• Equip leaders with the knowledge and tools necessary to effectively reinforce and role model the change within their teams.

• Develop and facilitate leadership training sessions, workshops, and one-on-one coaching to ensure leaders can confidently answer questions and drive continued adoption

3. System Expertise and Managing Minimal Viable Product (MVP)/Agile Changes

• Develop deep expertise in all new and existing systems, ensuring the ability to anticipate questions, challenges, and user adoption barriers. System expertise is including but not limited to CareConnect (web and mobile), TechConnect, Kronos, Greenhouse, G-Suite (including Gemini), Scout, and the Pulse.

• Identify and proactively address issues that may arise with system changes, ensuring smooth integration into existing workflows.

• Manage staff through rapidly evolving system updates by providing clear communication, training, and support as changes are iterated upon.

• Adapt to a minimal viable product/agile (MVP) approach, recognizing that initial rollouts may require iterative improvements and ensuring that teams remain agile and engaged throughout the evolution of system changes.

4. Sustainment and Compliance

• Measure and track ongoing compliance with implemented changes through data reviews and case file audits.

• Identify areas of resistance and develop targeted interventions to reinforce change adoption.

• Establish mechanisms for continuous feedback and improvement to enhance change sustainability.

5. Change Champion and Leadership Development

• Identify and cultivate Change Champions within each region or department undergoing transformation.

• Equip leaders with the skills and tools necessary to manage change effectively within their teams.

• Facilitate workshops and leadership coaching sessions to build internal change capability.

5. Performance Measurement and Reporting

• Define and track key success metrics, including: Leadership competency: Observe and report on leadership’s ability to show high level of competency in change as measured through ability to articulate the reason for the change and model the change. Change adoption: Attainment of project outcomes as defined in the project charter. Satisfaction: Feedback from post-implementation surveys. Sustainability: Ongoing compliance through case file audits and data reviews. Provide regular reports and insights to leadership on the impact and effectiveness of change initiatives.

6. Compliance with Centria’s Code of Conduct, policies and procedures, and Federal and State laws.

7. Responsibility to report violations of Company policies or the Code of Conduct.

Qualifications

These guidelines can be used to make a list of qualifications required (or preferred) to perform the job successfully.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in business or relevant background and experience in organizational change

Preferred Work Experience

• 3+ years of experience in change management, organizational development, or process improvement.

• Strong facilitation and training skills with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders.

• Experience in leadership training and competency development, with a focus on ensuring leaders understand and can sustain change.

• Experience in the healthcare or ABA industry.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Manager, Data Centers
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As Senior Commercial Manager, Data Centers, you will drive the commercial activities that support Nebius's data center expansion and operations across the United States.You will be the primary point of coordination between our data center providers and internal Infrastructure, Legal, Finance, Treasury, and Procurement teams. Your scope will include provider funding requests, contractual commitments, change orders, prepayments, and commercial issues affecting delivery. We are looking for someone who takes ownership from the initial request through final execution: clarifying requirements, resolving open questions, securing approvals, coordinating signatures and payments, and confirming that commitments are fulfilled. You will need to work independently, manage competing priorities, and bring structure to complex situations.

This remote position will require travel between Data Centers.

Your responsibilities will include:

Provider commercial management

• Own the coordination of commercial matters with colocation providers, data center developers, and power infrastructure partners.

• Review provider requests for completeness, supporting documentation, contractual basis, and alignment with agreed scope and milestones.

• Coordinate negotiations on change orders, payment schedules, and other commercial arrangements with the relevant business owners and Legal.

• Track provider obligations and follow through on unresolved commitments, discrepancies, and disputes.

Funding and Payment Coordination

• Drive funding requests, milestone payments, deposits, and prepayments through internal review and approval.

• Maintain a consolidated view of requested, approved, committed, and paid amounts across projects.

jobs.title: Threat Hunter/Purple Team Operator
jobs.description:
Threat Hunter / Purple Team Operator

SIXGEN's mission is to deliver agile, mission-ready cybersecurity solutions that empower government and critical infrastructure organizations to stay ahead of advanced cyber threats. We combine innovation, deep expertise, and leading technical capabilities to uncover vulnerabilities, protect vital systems, and strengthen operational resilience.

POSITION OVERVIEW

• Position: Mid-Level Threat Hunter / Purple Team Operator

• Job Type: Full Time

• Location: Remote with travel to customers and test locations as required

• Clearance Requirement: Active Top Secret with SCI eligibility

WHAT YOU'LL DO

SIXGEN is seeking a mid-level Threat Hunter / Purple Team Operator to  identify threats that evade existing detection methods, develop and test hunting hypotheses, and feed findings back into detection engineering. This role will combine remote threat hunting and on-site purple team coordination in direct support of red team engagements to secure systems, strengthen the defenders, and build and validate detection methods that can catch offensive traffic in real time.

This role requires comfort working independently through remote hunts as well as the ability to translate adversary tradecraft into defensive guidance.

Responsibilities include:

• Conduct hypothesis-driven and intelligence-led threat hunts across endpoints, networks, and cloud telemetry for several weeks prior to each red team engagement.

• Analyze logs, alerts, and historical data for indicators of compromise (IOCs), anomalous behavior, and adversary TTPs mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK from partner-provided sources (EDR, SIEM, authentication/identify logs).

• Document hunt coverage and methodology, findings, detection recommendations, and any confirmed or suspected compromise, escalating immediately if active adversary activity is found.

• Deliver a threat hunt summary and determine if the customer environment is clear prior to red team assessments.

• Partner with blue teams during the purple portion of the engagement to assist in detecting, tuning, and validating controls against red team TTPs in real-time.

• Brief technical and non-technical stakeholders on hunt result and purple team detection outcomes.

• Serve as a Trusted Agent during the red team assessment and maintain strict confidentiality and operational security with insight into both red and blue team activity.

Technology proficiency includes:

• SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic).

• EDR/XDR tooling (e.g. CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, Carbon Black).

• Network detection and traffic analysis tools (e.g. Zeek, Suricata, full packet capture).

• Log aggregation and correlation across endpoint, network, cloud, and identity sources (e.g., Azure AD/Entra ID, AWS CloudTrail, Microsoft 365).

• MITRE ATT&CK framework for mapping hunts and detections to adversary TTPs.

• Query and scripting languages for hunting and automation (e.g. KQL, SPL, Python).

• Familiarity with common red team tooling and tradecraft (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Havoc, and other C2 traffic patterns) to help recognize and detect it.

WHAT YOU BRING

Required qualifications:

• 3 – 5+ years of experience in threat hunting, SOC/detection engineering, incident response, or a closely related defensive security role.

• Hand-on experience working with a major SIEM and EDR platform.

• Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and how to map observed activity to adversary TTPs.

• Understanding of common adversary tradecraft and red team testing methodology to help close detection gaps.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce clear, customer-facing findings and an “all clear” determination.

• Comfortable operating independently in remote, customer-facing roles.

• U.S. citizenship, with eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

• Industry certifications such as GCFA, GCIH, GNFA, GCTI, CySA+, or equivalent.

• Prior experience performing threat hunting and/or purple team role working directly alongside a red team.

• Scripting and automation experience to streamline hunting workflows (e.g., Python, PowerShell).

• Prior experience working with multiple partner organizations or client environments.

• Active TS/SCI clearance.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

SIXGEN offers competitive compensation based on the responsibilities of the role and the candidate's experience, qualifications, specialized expertise, and security-clearance status. The final compensation package will be discussed during the hiring process.

SIXGEN offers benefits for full-time employees, including:

• Employer-paid health insurance premiums, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, for employees and their families

• Employer-paid short- and long-term disability insurance and basic life and AD&D insurance

• 401(k) plan with a 4% employer contribution

• Professional-development reimbursement options for training, certifications, and education

• Flexible and remote-work policies for most positions

• Flexible paid time off and holiday schedule

For more information, please contact Human Strategist Amy Maxwell at amy.maxwell@sixgen.io.

OUR COMMITMENT

SIXGEN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, marital status, ancestry, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture that values diversity in our people and reflects the communities and customers we serve. We strive to attract and retain a diverse talent pool and to create an environment where everyone is empowered to do their best work.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Lab Infrastructure and Security
jobs.description:
About Plasmidsaurus

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.



We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.



Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.



Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.


Role Overview

At Plasmidsaurus, our infrastructure doesn't just run software. It powers the sequencers, robots, and compute systems that help scientists around the world speed up their research and get to breakthrough discoveries faster. We're looking for a Platform Engineer to build and scale the infrastructure behind our 10 labs worldwide. You'll work across networking, hardware, cloud infrastructure, automation, and security, and you’ll have the freedom to architect solutions to complex engineering challenges. Your work will directly shape how quickly we launch new labs, expand sequencing capacity, and deliver reliable results to scientists solving some of the most important problems in the world.



What You'll Do 



Architect and Scale Our Global Lab Networks


 - Design and scale the networks powering sequencers, robotics, and compute across our 10 global labs. Own network architecture and reliability, including pfSense, MikroTik, HA firewalls, VLANs, DHCP/DNS, Tailscale, and inter-site connectivity.

 - Architect and deploy networking for new labs and expansions, from rack and switch infrastructure to high-speed 10Gb connectivity between sequencers and storage.

 - Automate network provisioning and configuration with Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD to make infrastructure deployments faster, more consistent, and reliable.


Build Reliable, Scalable Lab Compute Infrastructure

 - Build and improve the infrastructure supporting our production hardware, including Illumina and Oxford Nanopore sequencers, Opentrons robots, lab instruments, GPU clusters, and storage. Own connectivity, observability, and scalability as sequencing capacity grows.

 - Build and maintain secure, automated device identity and access systems using PKI, AWS IAM Roles Anywhere, and SSH.


Engineer Security Into Our Infrastructure

 - Own and strengthen the security of our cloud infrastructure, web applications, and APIs through proactive testing, AI-assisted red teaming, and close collaboration with Product Engineering to resolve vulnerabilities.

 - Build and operate vulnerability management across cloud infrastructure, lab devices, and application dependencies, including scanning, patching, and secrets management.

 - Lead technical security incident response, from detection and containment through resolution and postmortems, continuously improving our ability to prevent and respond to threats.


You are someone who:

 - Loves solving hard infrastructure problems, especially where hardware, networking, and software intersect.

 - Thinks like a builder. You automate repetitive work, improve the systems you inherit, and enjoy taking projects from design through production.

 - Has deep technical curiosity and enjoys experimenting with new technologies, tools, and approaches.

 - Is proactive about production reliability and security, anticipating problems rather than waiting for things to break.

 - Thrives in high autonomy environments. You take ownership, move quickly, and make solid decisions about tradeoffs.

 - Is a team player. Communicates clearly, shares knowledge, and makes those around you better.


Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

 - 7+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, systems, or security engineering, ideally supporting physical production environments.

 - Strong experience automating infrastructure with Python, Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, including network device configuration and provisioning.

 - Deep networking expertise, including routing, VLANs, firewalls, DHCP/DNS, VPNs (including Tailscale), and high-availability architectures. Experience with pfSense or MikroTik strongly preferred.

 - Hands-on experience in AWS, including networking (VPC, site-to-cloud connectivity), IAM, and containerized workloads (ECS, Lambda)

 - Excellent Linux systems administration skills, including system services, deployments, containers, and infrastructure configuration.

 - Hands-on security engineering experience, including web/API penetration testing or red teaming, vulnerability and dependency scanning, and incident response.

 - Ownership of production reliability, including on-call responsibilities, diagnosing complex infrastructure failures, and restoring service quickly.

 - Experience using AI coding agents as a primary development tool across the software lifecycle, including infrastructure automation, development, and security testing.

 - Experience with PKI, certificate management, and secrets management, ideally including internal CAs, ACME, or AWS Private CA.

 - Experience building observability for fleets of production devices and services, including metrics, logging, and alerting.
   
   

We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with the job description as we seek out diverse and creative perspectives. Team members who love to learn and collaborate in an inclusive environment will thrive with us. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please let us know at careers@plasmidsaurus.com. careers@plasmidsaurus.com

jobs.title: Senior Space Red Team Operator
jobs.description:
Senior Space Red Team Operator

SIXGEN's mission is to deliver agile, mission-ready cybersecurity solutions that empower government and critical infrastructure organizations to stay ahead of advanced cyber threats. We combine innovation, deep expertise, and leading technical capabilities to uncover vulnerabilities, protect vital systems, and strengthen operational resilience.

POSITION OVERVIEW

• Position: Senior Space Red Team Operator

• Job Type: Full Time

• Location: Remote or Hybrid with travel to customer and test locations as required

• Clearance Requirement: Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance; active Secret or higher preferred

WHAT YOU'LL DO

SIXGEN is seeking a hands-on Senior Space Red Team Operator to lead authorized adversarial assessments of space systems and the infrastructure that supports them. You will evaluate attack paths across spacecraft, payload, ground, cloud, mission-network, and operator environments; develop safe and repeatable test methods; and translate technical findings into clear mission risk and practical engineering improvements. This role is suited to an operator who can move comfortably between Linux hosts, cloud services, embedded targets, and customer briefings while maintaining disciplined authorization and mission-safety boundaries.

Responsibilities include:

• Lead end-to-end red team assessments, penetration tests, and threat-informed adversary emulation against authorized space and mission systems.

• Develop assessment plans, attack paths, test cases, and Rules of Engagement that define objectives, authorization boundaries, safety controls, prohibited actions, and stop-work criteria.

• Assess Linux-based systems, embedded devices, flight and payload software, ground-station services, mission networks, cloud environments, and supporting applications for exploitable weaknesses.

• Research and validate vulnerabilities in firmware, operating systems, communications interfaces, authentication flows, APIs, containers, identity services, and other mission-relevant components.

• Create or adapt operator tooling, exploits, proof-of-concept code, automation, and test harnesses to support repeatable assessment objectives.

• Coordinate closely with system owners, engineers, operators, range personnel, and defensive teams to execute testing without unacceptable impact to safety, availability, or mission operations.

• Correlate technical access with realistic mission effects and help customers understand how weaknesses could affect command, telemetry, payload data, availability, or operational trust.

• Document evidence, reproduction steps, attack chains, severity, and prioritized remediation recommendations in clear technical reports and executive briefings.

• Support purple-team validation, detection engineering, remediation retesting, and after-action activities to confirm that identified attack paths have been reduced or closed.

• Mentor operators, contribute to internal tradecraft and lab development, and support technical scoping, customer discussions, and proposal efforts when needed.

WHAT YOU BRING

Required qualifications:

• Seven or more years of hands-on experience in red teaming, penetration testing, vulnerability research, exploit development, or closely related offensive security work; equivalent military, government, or industry experience will be considered.

• Advanced Linux knowledge, including networking, permissions, services, process behavior, logging, troubleshooting, and security controls.

• Hands-on embedded-systems knowledge, including firmware analysis, boot processes, hardware-software interfaces, common processor architectures, debugging, and at least some exposure to RTOS or embedded Linux environments.

• Practical cloud-security knowledge in at least one major platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including identity and access management, networking, logging, storage, compute, and common misconfiguration paths.

• Experience assessing enterprise networks and applications, including TCP/IP, routing, VPNs, DNS, authentication protocols, web services, APIs, and segmented or hybrid environments.

jobs.title: Sleep Scoring Technologist – RPSGT (PRN – Remote)
jobs.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

What you will be doing:

Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

We are seeking experienced sleep technologists for PRN Scoring positions. Qualified candidates must hold an active RPSGT credential along with a current license in the District of Columbia, Louisiana or Delaware. Candidates must also maintain current BLS/CPR certification and remain fully compliant with AASM continuing education requirements. The RPSGT PRN Scorer will work under the direct supervision of the Director of Clinical Relations, who operates under the guidance of the Medical Director

What success looks like:

Clinical Scoring and Analysis

• Analyze physiological data from HST monitoring devices, including EEG, respiratory signals, and oximetry, to identify sleep stages and respiratory events

• Interpret sleep architecture and patterns, arousal frequency, sleep efficiency and REM latency to support the diagnosis and management of sleep disorders

• Accurately read, compute and evaluate statistical metrics from a sleep interpretation report

• Identify and report pertinent clinical observations from raw data for clinical correlation by the interpreting sleep physician

• Accurately score assigned Home Sleep Test (HST) studies within two business days of receipt of uploaded study, barring technical issues. Monitor scoring queue daily

AASM Standards of Practice

• Score all HST studies in accordance with the most current version of the AASM Scoring Manual for the Scoring of Sleep and Associated Events: Rules, Terminology and Technical Specifications, applying the HST Recommended rules for sleep staging and respiratory events

• Review and edit all computer-assisted scoring on an epoch-by-epoch basis in compliance with the current AASM Scoring Manual

• Maintain scoring proficiency through ongoing participation in the AASM Inter-Scorer Reliability (ISR) program

Quality, Compliance, and Communication

• Uphold HIPAA and privacy requirements and adhere to all company policies and procedures

• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, accreditation standards and quality assurance protocols related to HST testing and scoring

• Troubleshoot technical issues with sleep monitoring equipment and software, escalating to the Director of Clinical Relations or technical support as needed

• Communicate effectively with team members through encrypted email and approved internal platforms

Credential and License Maintenance

• Maintain an active RPSGT credential and all required state licenses without lapse, including submitting renewal documentation and fees to the appropriate state agency in a timely manner, and notify Beacon immediately of any lapse in licensure for the state(s) in which you were hired

• Obtain and manage continuing education credits in accordance with BRPT standards, and forward all CEU certificates to the Director of Clinical Relations

What you will bring:

Experience

• Minimum of five years of experience as an RPSGT performing in-lab polysomnography

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience analyzing and scoring Home Sleep Apnea Tests (HSAT/HST)

Education

• High school diploma or equivalent required; two years of college coursework preferred

Credentials and Certifications

• Active Registered Polysomnographic Technologist (RPSGT) credential in good standing with the Board of Registered Polysomnographic Technologists (BRPT)

• Current CPR/BLS certification through the American Heart Association or an equivalent provider

• Current state license where required by the applicable state jurisdiction

• Completion of 30 CEUs within a rolling 36-month period

Knowledge

• Familiarity with, or ability to quickly learn, Beacon SV software and related policies and procedures for HST scoring

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with consistent follow-through

• Sound critical thinking and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• A collaborative, team-oriented approach and positive working relationships with colleagues

• Maintain a secure, reliable, high-speed home internet connection and a dedicated, HIPAA-compliant workspace

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.
